title: Autonomous agents for electricity-system planning
title_zh: 用于电力系统规划的自主智能体

paragraphs.en: Planning electricity systems requires repeated decisions that connect regional resources, investment, operation and network constraints. Here we present an autonomous planning framework that carries prepared regional scenarios through proposal, numerical evaluation, feedback interpretation, redesign and final plan selection. Agents propose investment bounds, storage operating conditions and feeder interventions, interpret numerical feedback, and decide how to revise designs and when to stop. The framework automatically executes annual investment-and-dispatch optimization and representative-feeder verification, applies fixed acceptance criteria and retains the lowest-cost accepted candidate. We evaluate forty carbon-constrained trajectories across ten system–year scenarios in five electricity systems and four countries, using two model deployments and single- and multi-agent architectures. All forty retain candidates satisfying the implemented physical and fixed annual operational carbon-budget checks. Twenty-eight of forty matched reference designs exceed the new scenario ceilings. A separate archive of ninety-six trajectories under a common 1,000 Mt annual ceiling provides matched references and broader regional coverage. The results demonstrate autonomous planning under explicit emissions constraints using public regional data and published institutional demand outlooks.
paragraphs.zh: 电力系统规划需要反复进行一系列决策，将区域资源、投资、运行与网络约束联系起来。 我们提出一个自主规划框架，将已 prepared 的区域情景依次通过提案、数值评估、反馈解读、重新设计和最终方案选择。 智能体提出投资边界、储能运行条件和馈线干预措施，解读数值反馈，并决定如何修改设计以及何时停止。 该框架自动执行年度投资与调度优化以及代表性馈线校验，应用固定的接受准则，并保留成本最低的可行候选方案。 我们在五个电力系统和四个国家中，针对十个系统-年情景评估四十条碳约束轨迹，采用两种模型部署以及单智能体和多智能体架构。 全部四十条轨迹均保留了满足所实施的物理校验和固定年度运行碳预算校验的候选方案。 四十条轨迹中，有二十八条与参考设计匹配后超出了新情景的上限。 一个在共同 1,000 Mt 年度上限下的九十六条轨迹的独立档案库提供了匹配的参考和更广泛的区域覆盖。 结果表明，利用公开的区域数据和已发布的机构需求展望，可以在明确的排放约束下实现自主规划。

paragraphs.en: Electricity-system planning is becoming more urgent as AI data centres, electric vehicles, industrial electrification and rising cooling demand accelerate electricity use. The International Energy Agency projects global electricity demand to grow by an average of 3.6% annually from 2026 to 2030, with data centres accounting for around half of the increase in the United States [ 1 ] . This growth coincides with constrained grid connections, ageing infrastructure and increasing exposure to extreme weather. Large, concentrated data-centre loads link computing operations to local grid reliability and infrastructure costs [ 2 ] . Decisions about generation, storage and network expansion therefore shape both the reliability of electricity supply and the cost of long-lived infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 随着人工智能数据中心、电动汽车、工业电气化和不断增长的制冷需求加速电力消耗，电力系统规划变得更加紧迫。 国际能源署预计，2026 年至 2030 年全球电力需求将年均增长 3.6%，其中在美国，数据中心约占增量的一半 [ 1 ] 。 这一增长恰逢电网接入受限、基础设施老化以及极端天气暴露程度不断上升。 大型、集中的数据中心负荷将计算运营与当地电网可靠性和基础设施成本联系在一起 [ 2 ] 。 因此，关于发电、储能和电网扩建的决策既影响电力供应的可靠性，也影响长寿命基础设施的成本。

paragraphs.en: Capacity-expansion research examines these decisions through coupled investment and operation, including the representation of storage [ 3 ] . Spatial studies coordinate renewable deployment with transmission and storage [ 4 ] , and recent global models jointly optimize investment and hourly operation at fine spatial resolution [ 5 ] . Local network studies show that electrical constraints and spatially varying flexibility opportunities also affect deployment [ 6 , 7 ] . An investment proposal changes how the regional system operates over the year. If the resulting dispatch exceeds a network limit, planners must decide whether to revise the portfolio, change storage operation or reinforce the network. The ability to repeat this process matters across countries with different electricity needs and analytical resources. Published work has documented the unequal geographic distribution of expertise in African energy modelling [ 8 ] ; comprehensive studies such as Net-Zero America illustrate the coordination required across generation and networks [ 9 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 容量扩展研究通过耦合投资与运行来考察这些决策，包括对储能的表示 [ 3 ] 。 空间研究将可再生能源部署与输电和储能相协调 [ 4 ] ，近年来的全球模型在高空间分辨率下对投资与逐小时运行进行联合优化 [ 5 ] 。 局部网络研究表明，电气约束以及随空间变化的灵活性机会也会影响部署 [ 6 , 7 ] 。 一项投资方案会改变区域系统全年的运行方式。 如果由此产生的调度超出网络限制，规划者必须决定是调整组合、改变储能运行还是加强网络。 在电力需求和分析资源各不相同的国家之间，重复这一流程的能力至关重要。 已发表的工作记录了非洲能源建模领域专业能力在地理分布上的不均衡 [ 8 ] ；诸如“净零美国”之类的综合性研究则展示了发电与网络之间所需的协调 [ 9 ] 。

paragraphs.en: US offshore wind projections vary with assumptions about technology costs, transmission and policy [ 10 ] . The location of new interregional transmission also affects costs and reliability during extreme events [ 11 ] . In western Europe, accounting for the effects of heat on demand and grid capacity reveals transmission bottlenecks [ 12 ] . Evaluating alternatives across regional systems requires repeated investment-and-dispatch optimization, network evaluation and revision of proposed designs. Full-year hourly operation and storage couple decisions across time, while finer temporal detail increases computational demands [ 13 ] . Surrogate models trained on numerical simulations can accelerate energy-system optimization [ 14 ] . Completing a planning study also requires interpreting numerical outputs, choosing design changes and deciding when to stop. We use pretrained language models to carry out these planning decisions through repeated numerical feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 美国海上风电的预测因对技术成本、输电和政策的假设不同而变化 [ 10 ] 。 新建跨区域输电线路的选址也会影响极端事件下的成本和可靠性 [ 11 ] 。 在西欧，考虑高温对需求和电网容量的影响可以揭示输电瓶颈 [ 12 ] 。 跨区域系统的方案评估需要反复进行投资与调度优化、网络评估以及对拟议设计方案的修订。 全年逐小时运行与储能使决策在时间上相互耦合，而更精细的时间分辨率会增加计算需求 [ 13 ] 。 基于数值模拟训练的代理模型可以加速能源系统优化 [ 14 ] 。 完成一项规划研究还需要解读数值结果、选择设计调整方案，并决定何时停止。 我们利用预训练语言模型，通过反复的数值反馈来执行这些规划决策。

paragraphs.en: Open models provide important components of this process. PyPSA optimizes investment and operation, PyPSA-Earth supports geographically extensive model construction, and OpenDSS resolves distribution voltages and currents [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] . Their integration raises a separate question: can agents autonomously carry a planning study from prepared regional inputs to a verified plan, interpreting physical feedback, revising designs and deciding when to stop?
paragraphs.zh: 开放模型为这一过程提供了重要组成部分。 PyPSA 优化投资与运行，PyPSA-Earth 支持构建地理范围广泛的大尺度模型，OpenDSS 求解配电网的电压与电流 [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] 。 将它们集成起来引出了一个独立的问题：智能体能否自主地将一项规划研究从准备好的区域输入推进到经过验证的规划方案，包括解读物理反馈、修改设计方案并决定何时停止？

Applications to distribution planning include a workflow with human oversight that evaluates reliability interventions on utility feeders [ 19 ] and a multi-agent approach to planning photovoltaic generation and electric vehicle charging within distribution networks [ 20 ] . paragraphs.en: Here we develop and evaluate an autonomous electricity-planning framework that connects regional investment and annual operation with representative-feeder verification. To our knowledge, no previous study has demonstrated a planning process across multiple regional electricity systems in which language-model agents revise investment proposals using feedback from both year-round dispatch and distribution network checks. The framework carries the planning process from prepared inputs through feedback-driven redesign and agent-directed stopping to final plan selection across heterogeneous regional and future conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 在此我们提出并评估了一个自主的电力规划框架，该框架将区域投资与年度运行相衔接，并通过代表性馈线进行校验。 据我们所知，此前尚无研究在多个区域电力系统中展示过这样的规划过程：语言模型智能体利用全年调度和配电网校验的反馈来修订投资方案。 该框架将规划过程从准备好的输入出发，经历基于反馈的重新设计和由智能体主导的停止判定，最终在异质的区域与未来情景下完成方案选择。

sents.en: The framework carries the planning process from prepared inputs through feedback-driven redesign and agent-directed stopping to final plan selection across heterogeneous regional and future conditions.
sents.zh: 该框架将规划过程从准备好的输入出发，经历基于反馈的重新设计和由智能体主导的停止判定，最终在异质的区域与未来情景下完成方案选择。

paragraphs.en: Once a regional scenario is supplied, the framework carries out the planning loop autonomously. Agents interpret regional inputs and numerical feedback to choose technology permissions, investment bounds, storage operating conditions and feeder interventions. PySAM converts regional weather inputs into hourly photovoltaic generation profiles. A turbine power curve supplies the wind profiles. PyPSA uses these profiles to select investments and hourly dispatch within the proposed bounds. OpenDSS then screens the dispatch on representative feeders. The framework automatically executes the required system and feeder evaluations, returns their evidence to the agents and applies fixed acceptance criteria. Agents use this feedback to choose subsequent design changes and decide whether to continue or stop. The framework preserves the lowest-cost accepted candidate found so far in a separate reporting record and returns it as the final result. This adaptation takes place at inference time, without task-specific training or fine-tuning of model weights. Single agents maintain strategy notes, whereas specialist teams additionally maintain an advisory procedure graph inspired by procedural memory [ 21 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 一旦提供了区域场景，该框架便自主执行规划循环。 智能体解读区域输入和数值反馈，以选择技术许可、投资边界、储能运行条件和馈线干预措施。 PySAM 将区域天气输入转换为逐时光伏发电出力曲线。 风电出力曲线由风机功率曲线提供。 PyPSA 利用这些出力曲线在提议的边界内选择投资和逐时调度。 OpenDSS 随后在代表性馈线上对该调度进行筛查。 该框架自动执行所需的系统与馈线评估，将评估证据返回给智能体，并应用固定的接受准则。 智能体利用这些反馈来选择后续的设计更改，并决定是继续还是停止。 该框架将迄今为止发现的成本最低的已接受候选方案保存在单独的报告记录中，并将其作为最终结果返回。 这种适配在推理阶段进行，无需针对任务的训练或对模型权重进行微调。 单一智能体维护策略笔记，而专家团队还额外维护一个受程序性记忆启发的建议流程图 [ 21 ] 。

sents.en: Once a regional scenario is supplied, the framework carries out the planning loop autonomously.
sents.zh: 一旦提供了区域场景，该框架便自主执行规划循环。

sents.en: Agents interpret regional inputs and numerical feedback to choose technology permissions, investment bounds, storage operating conditions and feeder interventions.
sents.zh: 智能体解读区域输入和数值反馈，以选择技术许可、投资边界、储能运行条件和馈线干预措施。

sents.en: PySAM converts regional weather inputs into hourly photovoltaic generation profiles.
sents.zh: PySAM 将区域天气输入转换为逐时光伏发电出力曲线。

sents.en: A turbine power curve supplies the wind profiles.
sents.zh: 风电出力曲线由风机功率曲线提供。

sents.en: PyPSA uses these profiles to select investments and hourly dispatch within the proposed bounds.
sents.zh: PyPSA 利用这些出力曲线在提议的边界内选择投资和逐时调度。

sents.en: OpenDSS then screens the dispatch on representative feeders.
sents.zh: OpenDSS 随后在代表性馈线上对该调度进行筛查。

sents.en: The framework automatically executes the required system and feeder evaluations, returns their evidence to the agents and applies fixed acceptance criteria.
sents.zh: 该框架自动执行所需的系统与馈线评估，将评估证据返回给智能体，并应用固定的接受准则。

sents.en: Agents use this feedback to choose subsequent design changes and decide whether to continue or stop.
sents.zh: 智能体利用这些反馈来选择后续的设计更改，并决定是继续还是停止。

sents.en: The framework preserves the lowest-cost accepted candidate found so far in a separate reporting record and returns it as the final result.
sents.zh: 该框架将迄今为止发现的成本最低的已接受候选方案保存在单独的报告记录中，并将其作为最终结果返回。

sents.en: This adaptation takes place at inference time, without task-specific training or fine-tuning of model weights.
sents.zh: 这种适配在推理阶段进行，无需针对任务的训练或对模型权重进行微调。

sents.en: Single agents maintain strategy notes, whereas specialist teams additionally maintain an advisory procedure graph inspired by procedural memory [ 21 ] .
sents.zh: 单一智能体维护策略笔记，而专家团队还额外维护一个受程序性记忆启发的建议流程图 [ 21 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The primary evaluation comprises ten system–year scenarios across NYISO, MISO, South Africa, Mexico and Brazil. These five systems cover four countries and forty model zones. Each scenario is evaluated with GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 in both single- and multi-agent configurations, giving forty trajectories. The scenarios comprise NYISO in 2023, 2030 and 2035; MISO, South Africa and Brazil in 2030 and 2035; and Mexico in 2030. Four trajectories use 2023 demand and ERA5 resources, while thirty-six use future demand and resource profiles reconstructed for the matching target year from NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 daily fields and ERA5 intraday templates. Published allowance budgets, planning constraints and emissions pathways define fixed annual operational CO 2 ceilings under the mappings in Methods. A separate archive contains ninety-six trajectories across eight systems under the original 1,000 Mt annual ceiling. Forty of those trajectories match the primary cohort by system, year, deployment and architecture, while the remaining fifty-six provide broader regional and temporal coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 主要评估涵盖 NYISO、MISO、南非、墨西哥和巴西的十个系统—年份情景。 这五个系统覆盖四个国家和四十个建模区域。 每个情景均在单智能体与多智能体配置下用 GPT-6.1 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5 进行评估，共产生四十条轨迹。 这些情景包括 2023、2030 和 2035 年的 NYISO；2030 和 2035 年的 MISO、南非和巴西；以及 2030 年的墨西哥。 四条轨迹使用 2023 年的需求和 ERA5 资源数据，而三十六条轨迹使用根据 NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 逐日场和 ERA5 日内模板针对对应目标年份重建的未来需求和资源曲线。 已公布的配额预算、规划约束和排放路径在 Methods 中的映射下定义了固定的年度运行 CO 2 上限。 另一个独立档案包含在原始 1,000 Mt 年度上限下跨八个系统的九十六条轨迹。 其中四十条轨迹在系统、年份、部署和架构方面与主要队列匹配，其余五十六条则提供了更广泛的区域和时间覆盖。

paragraphs.en: Published expert plans provide a reference for interpreting the carbon-constrained portfolios in Brazil and South Africa in 2035. We compare technology-specific capacities where archived documents permit an explicit year and category mapping. The plans also supply some scenario inputs, including the adopted emissions ceilings, so the comparison describes portfolio differences under partially shared assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 已发布的专家规划为解读2035年巴西和南非受碳排放约束的电力组合提供了参考。 在归档文件允许进行明确的年份和类别对应的情况下，我们对特定技术的装机容量进行比较。 这些规划还提供了一些情景输入，包括所采用的排放上限，因此该比较描述的是在部分共享假设下的电力组合差异。

paragraphs.en: Across all forty carbon-constrained trajectories the agents completed the planning cycle and the framework retained a design that passed the implemented system, feeder and emissions checks. The separate loose-cap archive shows how agents revised their proposals and when feeder checks ruled out a lower-cost alternative.
paragraphs.zh: 在全部四十条碳排放约束情景轨迹中，各智能体均完成了规划周期，且该框架所保留的设计通过了已实施的系统、馈线与排放校验。 独立的松散方案归档显示各智能体如何修订其提案，以及馈线校验何时排除了一个成本更低的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: The framework assigns distinct roles to resource, system and distribution models (Fig. 1 ). PySAM converts irradiance to photovoltaic output, and a reference turbine curve converts wind speeds to generation potential. PyPSA selects additions and hourly dispatch within agent-specified technology permissions, siting bounds and storage operating envelopes. OpenDSS evaluates that dispatch on representative feeders. Agents use the resulting evidence to choose the next experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架为资源、系统和配电模型分配了不同的角色（图 1）。 PySAM 将辐照度转换为光伏出力，一条参考风机功率曲线将风速转化为发电潜力。 PyPSA 在智能体指定的技术许可、选址边界和储能运行包络范围内选择新增容量与逐小时调度。 OpenDSS 在代表性馈线上评估该调度方案。 智能体利用所得证据选择下一个实验。

sents.en: The framework assigns distinct roles to resource, system and distribution models (Fig. 1 ).
sents.zh: 该框架为资源、系统和配电模型分配了不同的角色（图 1）。

sents.en: PySAM converts irradiance to photovoltaic output, and a reference turbine curve converts wind speeds to generation potential.
sents.zh: PySAM 将辐照度转换为光伏出力，一条参考风机功率曲线将风速转化为发电潜力。

sents.en: PyPSA selects additions and hourly dispatch within agent-specified technology permissions, siting bounds and storage operating envelopes.
sents.zh: PyPSA 在智能体指定的技术许可、选址边界和储能运行包络范围内选择新增容量与逐小时调度。

sents.en: OpenDSS evaluates that dispatch on representative feeders.
sents.zh: OpenDSS 在代表性馈线上评估该调度方案。

sents.en: Agents use the resulting evidence to choose the next experiment.
sents.zh: 智能体利用所得证据选择下一个实验。

paragraphs.en: In the primary evaluation, the annual operational CO 2 budget is a fixed scenario input enforced within each system optimization. The agent cannot relax this budget. Acceptance also checks the reported emissions against the fixed ceiling, alongside the system and representative-feeder requirements. The budget constrains direct operational emissions within the model boundary and does not establish compliance with the full institutional policy or planning framework from which its numerical value was drawn.
paragraphs.zh: 在主要评估中，年度运营二氧化碳预算是一个固定的情景输入，并在每个系统优化中被强制执行。 智能体不能放宽这一预算。 验收除了检查系统和代表性馈线的要求外，还会将所报告的排放量与固定上限进行核对。 该预算约束的是模型边界内的直接运营排放，并不能确立对其数值所源自的完整机构政策或规划框架的合规性。

sents.en: In the primary evaluation, the annual operational CO 2 budget is a fixed scenario input enforced within each system optimization.
sents.zh: 在主要评估中，年度运营二氧化碳预算是一个固定的情景输入，并在每个系统优化中被强制执行。

sents.en: The agent cannot relax this budget.
sents.zh: 智能体不能放宽这一预算。

sents.en: Acceptance also checks the reported emissions against the fixed ceiling, alongside the system and representative-feeder requirements.
sents.zh: 验收除了检查系统和代表性馈线的要求外，还会将所报告的排放量与固定上限进行核对。

sents.en: The budget constrains direct operational emissions within the model boundary and does not establish compliance with the full institutional policy or planning framework from which its numerical value was drawn.
sents.zh: 该预算约束的是模型边界内的直接运营排放，并不能确立对其数值所源自的完整机构政策或规划框架的合规性。

paragraphs.en: The single-agent architecture maintains one conversation and strategy notes. The multi-agent architecture separates specialist proposals, orchestration, evaluation, criticism, procedure refinement, compression and convergence judgement. Both architectures receive system and feeder evidence for every successful committed solve. In the multi-agent architecture, hypothetical system-only verifications support the judge’s decision to continue or stop within the current cycle. A candidate is physically accepted only after its committed system and distribution results satisfy every applicable physical and carbon-budget check. Throughout the search, a separate reporting record retains the lowest all-in-cost committed candidate that has passed every applicable physical and carbon-budget check, without changing the agents’ prompts or stopping decisions. This candidate is reported when the search ends through an agent stopping decision or the configured search ceiling.
paragraphs.zh: 单智能体架构维护一个对话和策略笔记。 多智能体架构将专家提案、编排、评估、批评、流程细化、压缩和收敛判断分离开来。 两种架构在每次成功提交求解时都会接收系统与馈线证据。 在多智能体架构中，仅基于系统的假设性验证支持评判者在当前周期内继续或停止的决策。 只有当候选方案已提交的系统与分配结果满足所有适用的物理与碳预算检查后，才会被实际接受。 在整个搜索过程中，一个独立的报告记录会保留已通过所有适用物理与碳预算检查、且综合成本最低的已提交候选方案，而不改变智能体的提示词或停止决策。 当搜索通过智能体的停止决策或配置的搜索上限结束时，报告该候选方案。

sents.en: The single-agent architecture maintains one conversation and strategy notes.
sents.zh: 单智能体架构维护一个对话和策略笔记。

sents.en: The multi-agent architecture separates specialist proposals, orchestration, evaluation, criticism, procedure refinement, compression and convergence judgement.
sents.zh: 多智能体架构将专家提案、编排、评估、批评、流程细化、压缩和收敛判断分离开来。

sents.en: Both architectures receive system and feeder evidence for every successful committed solve.
sents.zh: 两种架构在每次成功提交求解时都会接收系统与馈线证据。

sents.en: In the multi-agent architecture, hypothetical system-only verifications support the judge’s decision to continue or stop within the current cycle.
sents.zh: 在多智能体架构中，仅基于系统的假设性验证支持评判者在当前周期内继续或停止的决策。

sents.en: A candidate is physically accepted only after its committed system and distribution results satisfy every applicable physical and carbon-budget check.
sents.zh: 只有当候选方案已提交的系统与分配结果满足所有适用的物理与碳预算检查后，才会被实际接受。

sents.en: Throughout the search, a separate reporting record retains the lowest all-in-cost committed candidate that has passed every applicable physical and carbon-budget check, without changing the agents’ prompts or stopping decisions.
sents.zh: 在整个搜索过程中，一个独立的报告记录会保留已通过所有适用物理与碳预算检查、且综合成本最低的已提交候选方案，而不改变智能体的提示词或停止决策。

sents.en: This candidate is reported when the search ends through an agent stopping decision or the configured search ceiling.
sents.zh: 当搜索通过智能体的停止决策或配置的搜索上限结束时，报告该候选方案。

paragraphs.en: Every search is initialized with the engine’s default design, which permits all extendable technologies, sets capacity bounds to their maxima and uses four-hour batteries without feeder interventions. Agents may modify this design before the first committed simulation. In the primary cohort, every system optimization includes the scenario-specific carbon budget. Agents then revise design restrictions and feeder controls using numerical feedback. Final selection retains the lowest all-in-cost committed candidate satisfying every implemented physical check and the fixed carbon budget. This selection rule is applied independently of the last proposal evaluated and the agent’s stopping decision.
paragraphs.zh: 每次搜索都以引擎的默认设计初始化，该设计允许所有可扩展技术，将容量界限设为最大值，并使用四小时电池且不对馈线进行干预。 智能体可以在第一次提交的仿真之前修改该设计。 在主要队列中，每次系统优化都包含特定场景的碳预算。 智能体随后利用数值反馈修改设计限制与馈线控制。 最终选择保留满足所有已实施物理校验以及固定碳预算的全成本最低的已提交候选方案。 该选择规则的应用与最后评估的提案以及智能体的停止决策无关。

sents.en: Every search is initialized with the engine’s default design, which permits all extendable technologies, sets capacity bounds to their maxima and uses four-hour batteries without feeder interventions.
sents.zh: 每次搜索都以引擎的默认设计初始化，该设计允许所有可扩展技术，将容量界限设为最大值，并使用四小时电池且不对馈线进行干预。

sents.zh: 智能体可以在第一次提交的仿真之前修改该设计。

sents.en: In the primary cohort, every system optimization includes the scenario-specific carbon budget.
sents.zh: 在主要队列中，每次系统优化都包含特定场景的碳预算。

sents.en: Agents then revise design restrictions and feeder controls using numerical feedback.
sents.zh: 智能体随后利用数值反馈修改设计限制与馈线控制。

sents.en: Final selection retains the lowest all-in-cost committed candidate satisfying every implemented physical check and the fixed carbon budget.
sents.zh: 最终选择保留满足所有已实施物理校验以及固定碳预算的全成本最低的已提交候选方案。

sents.en: This selection rule is applied independently of the last proposal evaluated and the agent’s stopping decision.
sents.zh: 该选择规则的应用与最后评估的提案以及智能体的停止决策无关。

paragraphs.en: The primary cohort contains forty completed trajectories across ten system–year scenarios. All forty retain an accepted committed candidate under the implemented system, representative-feeder and carbon-budget checks. Each retained result is feasible within its modelled scenario and stated tolerances. Numerical optimality bounds apply to the optimizer’s domain for that candidate, rather than to every design the agent could have proposed.
paragraphs.zh: 主要队列包含十个系统-年份情景下的四十条已完成轨迹。 在所实施的系统、代表性馈线和碳预算检查下，全部四十条均保留了一个被接受的已提交候选方案。 每个保留结果在其建模情景和所述容差范围内均是可行的。 数值最优性界适用于该候选方案所对应求解器的求解域，而非适用于智能体本可提出的每一个设计。

sents.en: The primary cohort contains forty completed trajectories across ten system–year scenarios.
sents.zh: 主要队列包含十个系统-年份情景下的四十条已完成轨迹。

sents.en: All forty retain an accepted committed candidate under the implemented system, representative-feeder and carbon-budget checks.
sents.zh: 在所实施的系统、代表性馈线和碳预算检查下，全部四十条均保留了一个被接受的已提交候选方案。

sents.en: Each retained result is feasible within its modelled scenario and stated tolerances.
sents.zh: 每个保留结果在其建模情景和所述容差范围内均是可行的。

paragraphs.en: The budget is active to within 10 − 5 10^{-5} Mt in twenty-eight retained outcomes across seven scenarios. NYISO 2023, Mexico 2030 and South Africa 2030 retain emissions below their budgets in all four configurations. Complete outcome tables retain all four deployment–architecture trajectories for every scenario. Portfolio and geographic illustrations select the lowest observed all-in annual cost among the four accepted candidates for each displayed system and year. GPT-6.1 Sol single-agent supplies all ten displayed portfolios, attaining the unique observed minimum in six scenarios and a minimum shared with another configuration in four, using a USD 10 annual-cost tie tolerance. These illustrations describe achieved designs; they do not establish that one deployment or architecture is generally superior. Comparisons of deployment or architecture retain every matched pair and the candidate-specific numerical bounds.
paragraphs.zh: 预算在七个场景的二十八个保留结果中活跃，误差在 10^{-5} Mt 以内。 NYISO 2023、墨西哥 2030 和南非 2030 在全部四种配置下排放均低于其预算。 完整结果表为每个场景保留全部四条部署—架构轨迹。 组合与地理示例在每个展示系统和年份的四个已接受候选者中，选择观测到的最低全含年度成本。 GPT-6.1 Sol 单智能体提供了全部十个展示组合，在六个场景中取得唯一观测最小值，在四个场景中与其他配置共享最小值，使用 10 美元年度成本并列容差。 这些示例描述的是已实现的设计；它们并不表明某种部署或架构总体上更优。 部署或架构的比较保留了每一个匹配对以及特定候选者的数值界限。

sents.en: The budget is active to within 10 − 5 10^{-5} Mt in twenty-eight retained outcomes across seven scenarios.
sents.zh: 预算在七个场景的二十八个保留结果中活跃，误差在 10^{-5} Mt 以内。

sents.en: NYISO 2023, Mexico 2030 and South Africa 2030 retain emissions below their budgets in all four configurations.
sents.zh: NYISO 2023、墨西哥 2030 和南非 2030 在全部四种配置下排放均低于其预算。

sents.en: Complete outcome tables retain all four deployment–architecture trajectories for every scenario.

paragraphs.en: For each of the ten system–year scenarios, we select the lowest observed all-in annual cost among four candidates satisfying the physical and carbon-budget checks. Figure 3 pairs the resulting grid additions with operational emissions for the latest evaluated year in each system. NYISO, MISO, South Africa and Brazil use 2035, while Mexico uses 2030. The years are explicit because these panels do not form a common-year comparison. All ten scenarios remain in the outcome tables and the detailed atlas.

paragraphs.en: We compare the four retained accepted carbon-constrained outcomes for each of Brazil and South Africa in 2035 with technology-specific capacities from PDE 2035 and IRP 2025 (Table 2 ). These eight candidates satisfy their physical checks and annual model emissions budgets of 29 and 142 MtCO 2 , respectively. The comparisons use total capacity, including inherited assets, and retain all four deployment–architecture configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将巴西和南非在2035年保留的四个已接受的碳约束情景，与PDE 2035和IRP 2025中特定技术的装机容量进行比较（表2）。 这八个候选情景均满足其物理校验以及分别为29和142 MtCO2的年度模型排放预算。 比较采用总装机容量（包括继承的存量资产），并保留全部四种部署架构配置。

paragraphs.en: Brazil’s four outcomes contain 120.19 GW of wind, compared with 49.55 GW in PDE 2035. Their 96.66 GW of model solar is compared with the plan’s 29.19 GW centralized-solar category, which excludes a further 78.10 GW of micro-/mini-distributed generation. The model does not represent a separate future distributed-generation rollout, so this category-level difference does not measure a difference in total national photovoltaic capacity. The plan includes 6.63 GW of batteries, whereas all four carbon-constrained outcomes contain zero battery capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 巴西的四个结果包含 120.19 GW 风电，而 PDE 2035 中为 49.55 GW。 模型中的 96.66 GW 太阳能，与计划的 29.19 GW 集中式太阳能类别相比，该类别未计入另外 78.10 GW 的微型/小型分布式发电。 模型并未单独表示未来的分布式发电推广，因此这一类别层面的差异并不能衡量全国光伏总装机容量的差异。 计划包含 6.63 GW 的电池储能，而四个碳排放受约束的结果中电池容量均为零。

paragraphs.en: South Africa’s outcomes contain 5.57–6.24 GW of wind and 63.02–64.24 GW of solar. The IRP schedule yields 26.39 GW of wind and 21.16 GW in its Solar PV column by 2035, with 16.07 GW in a separate distributed-generation column. The portfolios therefore retain a different technology balance while satisfying the adopted annual emissions ceiling. The numerical ceilings share institutional sources with the capacity references, while resource, retirement, technology and delivery assumptions remain distinct. These comparisons describe the resulting portfolios rather than validate them against withheld planning targets.
paragraphs.zh: 南非的方案结果包含5.57–6.24吉瓦的风电和63.02–64.24吉瓦的太阳能。 按照综合资源规划（IRP）的时间表，到2035年其风电为26.39吉瓦，其太阳能光伏列为21.16吉瓦，另有一个独立的分布式发电列为16.07吉瓦。 因此，这些投资组合在满足所采用的年度排放上限的同时，保留了不同的技术构成。 这些数值上限与容量参考值来自相同的制度来源，而资源、退役、技术和交付方面的假设则保持各自独立。 这些比较是对所得投资组合的描述，而非将其与预留的规划目标进行验证。

paragraphs.en: The forty carbon-constrained trajectories contain 202 logical system-evaluation requests, comprising 130 committed simulation requests and 72 hypothetical system-only verification requests. These counts include requests served through exact-result reuse. The archived summaries record 764 received model responses, 90,562,224 input tokens and 1,314,432 output tokens. Input includes reported cache reads and writes, and output includes the reported reasoning subset. Provider usage conventions, recovery histories and the result-reuse revision remain attached to the trajectory evidence. The counts describe search effort rather than a controlled wall-runtime benchmark.

paragraphs.en: The original cohort used an annual CO 2 ceiling of 1,000 Mt. We retain its ninety-six trajectories as a separate reference dataset and compare the forty trajectories matching the primary cohort by system, year, deployment and architecture. Twenty-eight of these reference designs exceed the tighter budgets, corresponding to seven scenarios. The comparison reports achieved annual cost, operational emissions and investment portfolios for each matched pair. In NYISO 2035, the selected annual cost is USD 8.439 billion in all four carbon-constrained configurations, 23.56% above each matching loose-cap outcome. These observed contrasts are conditional on the archived trajectories and their respective optimization domains. A source-derived ceiling need not change the selected outcome when the corresponding loose-cap design already emits below it. Differences in binding and non-binding scenarios must therefore be distinguished when interpreting the response to a tighter budget.
paragraphs.zh: 原始队列采用了每年 1,000 Mt 的 CO₂ 上限。 我们将其九十六条轨迹保留为一个单独的参考数据集，并按系统、年份、部署情况和架构，将匹配主队列的四十条轨迹进行比较。 这些参考设计中有二十八个超出了更紧的预算，对应七个情景。 该比较报告了每一对匹配组合所实现的年度成本、运行排放和投资组合。 在 NYISO 2035 中，所选年度成本在所有四个碳约束配置下均为 84.39 亿美元，比每个对应的宽上限结果高出 23.56%。 这些观察到的差异取决于所归档的轨迹及其各自的优化域。 当对应的宽上限设计的排放量本已低于源数据推导出的上限时，该上限不必改变所选结果。 因此，在解读对更紧预算的响应时，必须区分约束性与非约束性情景的差异。

sents.zh: 这些参考设计中有二十八个超出了更紧的预算，对应七个情景。

sents.en: The comparison reports achieved annual cost, operational emissions and investment portfolios for each matched pair.
sents.zh: 该比较报告了每一对匹配组合所实现的年度成本、运行排放和投资组合。

sents.en: In NYISO 2035, the selected annual cost is USD 8.439 billion in all four carbon-constrained configurations, 23.56% above each matching loose-cap outcome.
sents.zh: 在 NYISO 2035 中，所选年度成本在所有四个碳约束配置下均为 84.39 亿美元，比每个对应的宽上限结果高出 23.56%。

sents.en: These observed contrasts are conditional on the archived trajectories and their respective optimization domains.
sents.zh: 这些观察到的差异取决于所归档的轨迹及其各自的优化域。

sents.en: A source-derived ceiling need not change the selected outcome when the corresponding loose-cap design already emits below it.
sents.zh: 当对应的宽上限设计的排放量本已低于源数据推导出的上限时，该上限不必改变所选结果。

sents.en: Differences in binding and non-binding scenarios must therefore be distinguished when interpreting the response to a tighter budget.
sents.zh: 因此，在解读对更紧预算的响应时，必须区分约束性与非约束性情景的差异。

paragraphs.en: These are comparisons of archived agent trajectories under different scenario inputs. The 2023 Opus reference used a 16,000-token output ceiling and an earlier provider adapter, whereas the primary campaign used a 64,000-token ceiling and the updated adapter. Those two NYISO pairs are reported separately from the other matched pairs. Execution revisions and exact-result reuse are also recorded, and one trajectory per condition does not support estimates of stochastic variation or an isolated causal effect of the carbon ceiling on the full agent search.
paragraphs.zh: 这些是在不同场景输入下对归档智能体轨迹的比较。 2023 年的 Opus 参考使用了 16,000 token 的输出上限和较早的提供商适配器，而主要活动则使用了 64,000 token 的上限和更新后的适配器。 这两对 NYISO 配对与其他匹配的配对分开报告。 执行修订和精确结果复用也有记录，且每个条件仅一条轨迹无法支持对随机变异的估计，也无法支持对碳上限在整个智能体搜索中的孤立因果效应的估计。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows the matched cost and emissions contrasts. Across the full loose-cap archive, 36 assessments in 16 searches had a lower annual objective than a previously accepted design but failed a feeder check. In one ERCOT 2035 search, removing a proposed line upgrade reduced the annual objective by 0.220% but caused three hours of undervoltage. The agent team restored the upgrade in the next round and the framework retained the earlier accepted design (Fig. 2 and Appendix 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了匹配的成本与排放对比。 在整个宽松上限档案中，16 次搜索里有 36 次评估的年度目标值低于先前接受的设计，但未通过馈线校验。 在一次 ERCOT 2035 搜索中，移除一项拟议的线路升级使年度目标值降低了 0.220%，却导致了三小时的欠电压。 智能体团队在下一轮恢复了该升级，且框架保留了先前接受的设计（图 2 与附录 7）。

paragraphs.en: The central result is autonomous execution of a coupled electricity-planning process across heterogeneous regional systems. Starting from prepared inputs, agents interpret numerical feedback, revise investment and operating decisions, and determine when to end the search. Automated system and representative-feeder evaluations, acceptance checks and final selection carry these decisions through to retained plans. All forty primary trajectories retain candidates satisfying the implemented physical and carbon-budget checks. Twenty-eight matched loose-cap reference designs exceed the new scenario ceilings. The budgets are enforced by the optimizer; agents navigate design choices and interpret system and representative-feeder evidence within these fixed constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 核心成果是在异构区域系统间自主执行一个耦合的电力规划流程。 从准备好的输入出发，智能体解读数值反馈、修订投资与运行决策，并判断何时结束搜索。 自动系统评估与代表性馈线评估、验收检查以及最终选择将这些决策落实为保留的规划方案。 全部四十条主要轨迹均保留了满足已实施的物理与碳预算检查的候选方案。 二十八个匹配宽松上限参考设计的方案超出了新情景的上限。 这些预算由优化器强制执行；智能体在这些固定约束内导航设计选择并解读系统与代表性馈线的证据。

sents.en: The central result is autonomous execution of a coupled electricity-planning process across heterogeneous regional systems.
sents.zh: 核心成果是在异构区域系统间自主执行一个耦合的电力规划流程。

sents.zh: 全部四十条主要轨迹均保留了满足已实施的物理与碳预算检查的候选方案。

sents.en: Twenty-eight matched loose-cap reference designs exceed the new scenario ceilings.
sents.zh: 二十八个匹配宽松上限参考设计的方案超出了新情景的上限。

sents.en: The budgets are enforced by the optimizer; agents navigate design choices and interpret system and representative-feeder evidence within these fixed constraints.
sents.zh: 这些预算由优化器强制执行；智能体在这些固定约束内导航设计选择并解读系统与代表性馈线的证据。

paragraphs.en: Comparisons between the carbon-constrained designs and published plans make the interpretation of numerical acceptance more concrete. Brazil’s larger modelled wind fleet and South Africa’s solar-heavy portfolio persist under the adopted emissions ceilings. Satisfying a plan-derived annual carbon budget therefore does not reproduce the plan’s technology mix. Model diagnostics document systematic differences in how energy models respond to scenario assumptions [ 23 ] ; transmission studies also expose trade-offs among cost, emissions and reliability under policy-driven and cost-minimizing designs [ 11 ] . Evidence from transition modelling further identifies roles for social acceptance, investment risk and infrastructure lock-in [ 24 ] . The portfolio differences identify retirement, resource, technology and staged-delivery assumptions for further sensitivity analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 将碳约束情景下的设计与已公布的规划进行对比，使对数值通过标准的具体阐释更加明确。 在所采用的排放上限之下，巴西规模更大的建模风电装机以及南非以太阳能为主的组合依然得以保留。 因此，满足源自规划的年度碳预算并不能再现该规划的技术组合。 模型诊断记录了能源模型对情景假设的响应方式存在系统性差异 [ 23 ]；输电研究也揭示了在政策驱动与成本最小化设计下成本、排放与可靠性之间的权衡 [ 11 ]。 来自转型建模的证据进一步确定了社会接受度、投资风险和基础设施锁定所起的作用 [ 24 ]。 这些组合差异指出了退役、资源、技术和分阶段交付方面的假设，可供进一步的敏感性分析。

sents.zh: 将碳约束情景下的设计与已公布的规划进行对比，使对数值通过标准的具体阐释更加明确。

paragraphs.en: Investment timing and available technologies remain important model boundaries. Apart from storage and the hydrogen chain, nuclear is the only new dispatchable technology in the simulator configuration; gas, coal and hydro plants exist only as inherited capacity. The single-period formulation makes selected additions available without a construction schedule, financing sequence or permitting constraint, while the inherited fleet remains available throughout the modelled year. Investment-pathway studies show why foresight and deployment timing matter for the transition [ 25 , 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 投资时点与可用技术仍是重要的模型边界。 除储能与氢能链条外，核电是模拟器配置中唯一的新建可调度技术；燃气、燃煤与水电站仅以继承容量的形式存在。 单期建模使得所选新增容量在无建设进度、融资安排或审批约束的情况下即可用，而继承机组在整个建模年份内始终可用。 投资路径研究说明了为什么前瞻性与部署时机对转型至关重要 [ 25 , 4 ] 。

sents.en: Investment timing and available technologies remain important model boundaries.
sents.zh: 投资时点与可用技术仍是重要的模型边界。

paragraphs.en: The carbon-constrained cohort adopts numerical limits from several kinds of institutional evidence. Allowance budgets, planning constraints and projected emissions are not interchangeable policy instruments. Our source-to-model mappings turn these quantities into fixed annual model constraints, while retaining differences in geographical coverage, emissions accounting, inherited assets and resource assumptions. Mexico and Brazil additionally use published CO 2 -equivalent values as numerical proxies for direct operational CO 2 . These choices define research scenarios and do not demonstrate legal compliance, lifecycle decarbonization or reproduction of the complete institutional plans.
paragraphs.zh: 受碳约束的群体从多种类型的机构性证据中采用数值限额。 配额预算、规划约束和预测排放量并非可互换的政策工具。 我们的“来源到模型”映射将这些数量转化为固定的年度模型约束，同时保留在地理覆盖范围、排放核算、既有资产和资源假设方面的差异。 墨西哥和巴西还额外使用已发布的二氧化碳当量数值作为直接运营性二氧化碳的数值代理。 这些选择定义的是研究情景，并不能证明法律合规性、全生命周期脱碳或对完整机构规划的复现。

sents.zh: 受碳约束的群体从多种类型的机构性证据中采用数值限额。

paragraphs.en: Local data preparation, source interpretation and the predefined simulator interfaces remain essential expert contributions. Evaluation with regional practitioners would extend the study to systems with poorer network records, constrained financing or substantial unmet demand.
paragraphs.zh: 本地数据准备、源数据解读以及预定义的模拟器接口仍然是专家不可或缺的贡献。 与区域从业者的评估合作将把该研究扩展到网络记录较差、融资受限或存在大量未满足需求的系统。

paragraphs.en: Further development can address network detail, climate uncertainty and replication. Network evaluation uses reduced representative feeders and a zonal transport formulation. The fixed annual reliability tolerance permits limited unmet demand. Detailed AC network, contingency and site-level analyses would extend this representation.
paragraphs.zh: 进一步的发展可以解决网络细节、气候不确定性和可复制性的问题。 网络评估采用简化的代表性馈线和分区输电形式化模型。 固定的年度可靠性容差允许出现有限的未满足需求。 详细的交流（AC）网络、偶发事故和站级分析可以扩展这一表示方式。

sents.en: Further development can address network detail, climate uncertainty and replication.
sents.zh: 进一步的发展可以解决网络细节、气候不确定性和可复制性的问题。

sents.zh: 网络评估采用简化的代表性馈线和分区输电形式化模型。

sents.en: The fixed annual reliability tolerance permits limited unmet demand.
sents.zh: 固定的年度可靠性容差允许出现有限的未满足需求。

sents.zh: 详细的交流（AC）网络、偶发事故和站级分析可以扩展这一表示方式。

paragraphs.en: Weather-aware studies have coupled planning and operation across weather years or optimized under climate uncertainty and extremes [ 26 , 27 ] . Recent work further connects climate-sensitive adequacy to renewable siting and system flexibility [ 28 , 29 ] . Our future weather uses one climate model, one emissions scenario and synthetic hourly chronology. The change of data product between 2023 and the future years is not separated from projected climate change. A same-GCM historical control, multiple weather realizations and a climate-model ensemble would extend the analysis to climate attribution and robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 天气感知类研究已在多个天气年份间耦合规划与运行，或在气候不确定性与极端事件下进行优化 [ 26 , 27 ] 。 近期工作进一步将对气候敏感的充裕性与可再生能源选址及系统灵活性相联系 [ 28 , 29 ] 。 本文的未来天气使用一个气候模型、一种排放情景以及合成的逐小时时序。 2023 年与未来年份之间数据产品的变化未与预估的气候变化相分离。 采用同一 GCM 的历史对照、多个天气实现以及气候模型集合，将把分析扩展至气候归因与稳健性。

sents.zh: 天气感知类研究已在多个天气年份间耦合规划与运行，或在气候不确定性与极端事件下进行优化 [ 26 , 27 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Each deployment–architecture–scenario cell contains one trajectory, and campaign inference settings differ. Solver bounds apply to each candidate-specific optimization problem.
paragraphs.zh: 每个“部署–架构–场景”单元格包含一条轨迹，且各活动的推理设置有所不同。 求解器的边界约束适用于每个特定候选的优化问题。

paragraphs.en: A controlled expert comparison would hold inputs, technology options, reliability criteria and computational resources fixed, then evaluate both expert-guided and agent-guided candidates through the same independent gate. A complementary ablation would compare the adaptive loop with a predefined sequence of system and feeder checks. These tests would separate the contribution of adaptive decisions from the numerical models and data preparation.
paragraphs.zh: 受控的专家对比将固定输入、技术选项、可靠性判据和计算资源，然后通过同一个独立评审环节来评估专家引导与智能体引导的候选方案。 一项补充消融实验将自适应循环与预定义的系统及馈线检查序列进行对比。 这些测试将自适应决策的贡献与数值模型及数据准备的贡献区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The present results demonstrate autonomous completion of electricity-planning studies under fixed operational carbon budgets, grounded in public regional data and institutional demand outlooks, with the reference archive extending regional and temporal coverage. Explicit regional assumptions, committed dispatch, rejected and accepted candidates, and recorded search histories make both the resulting plans and the decisions leading to them inspectable.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究结果展示了在固定运行碳预算下，基于公开区域数据和机构需求预测自主完成电力规划研究的过程，且参考档案库扩展了区域和时间覆盖范围。 明确的区域假设、已提交的调度方案、被否决和被采纳的候选方案以及记录的搜索历史，使得最终规划结果及其决策过程均可被审查。

paragraphs.en: The primary evaluation covers five electricity systems in four countries, drawn from the broader eight-system, six-country input library in Table 3 ; the loose-cap reference evaluation covers all eight systems. Each system is represented as a coupled zonal planning problem in brownfield mode, with the inherited generation and storage fleet available for dispatch alongside optimized additions.
paragraphs.zh: 主要评估涵盖四个国家的五个电力系统，这些系统取自表3中更广泛的八系统、六国家输入数据库；宽松容量参考评估则涵盖全部八个系统。 每个系统被表示为一个存量改造模式下的耦合区域规划问题，其中继承下来的发电和储能机组可用于调度，并与优化的新增容量相结合。

paragraphs.en: Existing assets are assembled from dated inventory records and mapped to the model’s demand zones. The US packs use the 2023 EIA-860 inventory, including battery-energy schedules and the documented geographic and generator-identifier mappings. South African capacity follows Eskom’s 31 March 2023 nominal-fleet and independent-power-producer totals, with WRI plant coordinates and historical capacity weights supporting spatial allocation [ 38 ] . Australian registered capacities and maximum storage energies come from AEMO’s archived Registration and Exemption List; the December 2023 MMSDM dispatch-unit records identify units registered on 31 December 2023, with identifier-stem matching for batteries whose registration format changed. New Zealand uses the EMI generation inventory with commissioning and decommissioning dates to select units operating during 2023. Mexico uses the state-level technology capacities in PRODESEN 2024–2038, Annex 1, mapped to the model’s control regions. Brazil uses ONS unit-level effective capacities and entry/exit dates; the ANEEL SIGA register is retained as a coordinate reference in the source archive. Measured 2023 hydro generation supplies the annual hydro-energy budgets for New Zealand and Brazil. Availability factors, storage-duration fallbacks and regional allocation rules are declared modelling assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 现有资产根据有日期的库存记录汇集而成，并映射到模型的需求区域。 美国的电力包使用 2023 年 EIA-860 库存，包括电池储能时间表以及已记录的地理和发电机组标识符映射。 南非的装机容量遵循 Eskom 2023 年 3 月 31 日的名义机队和独立发电商总量，并利用 WRI 电厂坐标和历史容量权重支持空间分配 [ 38 ] 。 澳大利亚的注册容量和最大储能能量来自 AEMO 归档的注册与豁免清单；2023 年 12 月的 MMSDM 调度机组记录用于识别 2023 年 12 月 31 日注册的机组，并对注册格式发生变化的电池采用标识符词干匹配。 新西兰使用 EMI 发电库存，根据投运和退役日期筛选 2023 年期间运行的机组。 墨西哥使用 PRODESEN 2024–2038 附件 1 中的州级技术容量，并将其映射到模型的控制区域。 巴西使用 ONS 机组级有效容量和进入/退出日期；ANEEL SIGA 登记册作为坐标参考保留在源存档中。 2023 年实测水电发电量为新西兰和巴西提供年度水电能量预算。 可用性系数、储能时长回退值和区域分配规则均为声明的建模假设。

paragraphs.en: Inter-area transmission is a zonal abstraction constrained by published topology and limits where available. Each region carries a zonal network assembled from public documents (Table 4 ). Only zone pairs that are electrically adjacent in the source topology are corridors. Existing capacities are taken from published values where they exist, and published limits that apply to several paths at once are kept as interface constraints on the summed flow rather than converted to single-line ratings. MISO publishes zonal import and export limits rather than pairwise ratings, and these enter as zone constraints. Official planned projects are separate build decisions that raise the limits they cross by published increments where available and by declared assumptions otherwise. A generic additional circuit along each existing route is also available as a labelled assumption. Where an operator publishes no pairwise capacity, the corridor carries a non-binding proxy so that the published limits are the binding constraints; the published zonal and interface constraints remain explicit in the model.
paragraphs.zh: 区域间输电是一种区域抽象，在可用情况下受已公布拓扑结构和限额的约束。 每个区域包含一个根据公开文件构建的区域网络（表 4）。 只有在源拓扑中电气相邻的区域对才是联络通道。 现有容量在存在已公布数值时取自公布值，适用于多条路径的已公布限额则作为总流上的断面约束保留，而不转换为单线额定值。 MISO 公布的是区域进口和出口限额而非成对额定值，这些限额作为区域约束进入模型。 官方规划项目是单独的扩建决策，在可用情况下按公布增量提高其跨越的限额，否则按声明假设处理。 沿每条现有路径增设一条通用回路的方案也作为带标记的假设提供。 当运营商未公布成对容量时，联络通道携带一个非约束性的代理值，使已公布限额成为约束条件；已公布的区域约束和断面约束在模型中保持显式表达。

paragraphs.en: The ERCOT fixed limits retain specific study assumptions. The 12,240 MW limit is the RTP economic study’s 2027 West Texas Export value without outages, and 5,595 MW is the North-to-Houston base value with planned facilities. The source applies an hourly profile to the latter; our model holds the base value fixed. The 3,500 MW improvement reported for the full 765 kV STEP Core Plan, from 12,700 to 16,200 MW, is assigned to the Permian import-path candidate as an aggregate model approximation. Applied to the model’s 12,240 MW baseline, that assigned increment gives 15,740 MW before any additional generic-circuit increments.
paragraphs.zh: ERCOT 固定限额保留了特定研究假设。 12,240 MW 限额是 RTP 经济研究在无停运情况下的 2027 年西德克萨斯外送值，而 5,595 MW 是包含计划设施情况的北向至休斯顿基准值。 原来源对后者采用逐小时曲线；我们的模型则将基准值保持不变。 完整 765 kV STEP 核心计划所报告的 3,500 MW 提升幅度（从 12,700 MW 到 16,200 MW）被作为聚合模型近似分配给二叠纪进口路径候选方案。 应用于模型 12,240 MW 的基线后，该分配的增量在计入任何额外的通用线路增量之前给出 15,740 MW。

sents.en: The ERCOT fixed limits retain specific study assumptions.
sents.zh: ERCOT 固定限额保留了特定研究假设。

sents.en: The 12,240 MW limit is the RTP economic study’s 2027 West Texas Export value without outages, and 5,595 MW is the North-to-Houston base value with planned facilities.
sents.zh: 12,240 MW 限额是 RTP 经济研究在无停运情况下的 2027 年西德克萨斯外送值，而 5,595 MW 是包含计划设施情况的北向至休斯顿基准值。

sents.en: The source applies an hourly profile to the latter; our model holds the base value fixed.
sents.zh: 原来源对后者采用逐小时曲线；我们的模型则将基准值保持不变。

sents.en: The 3,500 MW improvement reported for the full 765 kV STEP Core Plan, from 12,700 to 16,200 MW, is assigned to the Permian import-path candidate as an aggregate model approximation.
sents.zh: 完整 765 kV STEP 核心计划所报告的 3,500 MW 提升幅度（从 12,700 MW 到 16,200 MW）被作为聚合模型近似分配给二叠纪进口路径候选方案。

sents.en: Applied to the model’s 12,240 MW baseline, that assigned increment gives 15,740 MW before any additional generic-circuit increments.
sents.zh: 应用于模型 12,240 MW 的基线后，该分配的增量在计入任何额外的通用线路增量之前给出 15,740 MW。

paragraphs.en: NYISO’s published Propel NY gain is 1,300 MW of additional import capability into Long Island. The model assigns 1,300 MW to both directions of the I–K corridor and to its selected ConEd–LIPA and Dunwoodie/Y49/Y50 interface constraints; reverse interface limits receive the increment where present. These mappings are proxies for the aggregate project benefit. New Zealand’s HVDC candidate increases northward capacity from 1,200 to 1,400 MW and assumes a southward increase from 850 to 1,000 MW. The possible fourth-cable enhancement in the TPR supports the northward target; the 150 MW southward increment is a study assumption.
paragraphs.zh: NYISO 公布的 Propel NY 增益是向长岛新增 1,300 MW 的输入能力。 模型将 1,300 MW 分配给 I–K 走廊的两个方向，并分配给其选定的 ConEd–LIPA 与 Dunwoodie/Y49/Y50 界面约束；在存在反向界面限制的地方，该增量也会计入反向界面限制。 这些映射关系是项目总体效益的代理指标。 新西兰的 HVDC 候选方案将向北输送能力从 1,200 MW 提升至 1,400 MW，并假设向南输送能力从 850 MW 提升至 1,000 MW。 TPR 中可能的第四条海底电缆增强方案支持向北输送目标；向南新增的 150 MW 是研究假设。

sents.en: NYISO’s published Propel NY gain is 1,300 MW of additional import capability into Long Island.
sents.zh: NYISO 公布的 Propel NY 增益是向长岛新增 1,300 MW 的输入能力。

sents.en: The model assigns 1,300 MW to both directions of the I–K corridor and to its selected ConEd–LIPA and Dunwoodie/Y49/Y50 interface constraints; reverse interface limits receive the increment where present.
sents.zh: 模型将 1,300 MW 分配给 I–K 走廊的两个方向，并分配给其选定的 ConEd–LIPA 与 Dunwoodie/Y49/Y50 界面约束；在存在反向界面限制的地方，该增量也会计入反向界面限制。

sents.en: These mappings are proxies for the aggregate project benefit.
sents.zh: 这些映射关系是项目总体效益的代理指标。

sents.en: New Zealand’s HVDC candidate increases northward capacity from 1,200 to 1,400 MW and assumes a southward increase from 850 to 1,000 MW.
sents.zh: 新西兰的 HVDC 候选方案将向北输送能力从 1,200 MW 提升至 1,400 MW，并假设向南输送能力从 850 MW 提升至 1,000 MW。

sents.en: The possible fourth-cable enhancement in the TPR supports the northward target; the 150 MW southward increment is a study assumption.
sents.zh: TPR 中可能的第四条海底电缆增强方案支持向北输送目标；向南新增的 150 MW 是研究假设。

paragraphs.en: MISO’s 3,000/2,500 MW constraints represent the physical regional directional transfer limits, separately from the auction’s subregional import/export allowances. South African corridor counts and the 31 TDP candidates are study aggregations of GIS records and planned lines; expected in-service years determine eligibility under the study’s stated rule. Australia’s archived nominal interconnector capabilities are held fixed, although realized capability depends on operating conditions. New Zealand’s 1,400 MW candidate represents the possible fourth-cable enhancement discussed alongside cable replacement, including the need to assess reactive support.
paragraphs.zh: MISO 的 3,000/2,500 MW 约束代表该地区实际的方向性传输物理极限，与拍卖中的次区域进口/出口额度是分开的。 南非的走廊数量和 31 个 TDP 候选项目是对 GIS 记录和规划线路的研究汇总；预期投运年份根据该研究所述规则决定其入选资格。 澳大利亚归档的标称联络线容量保持固定不变，尽管实际容量取决于运行条件。 新西兰的 1,400 MW 候选项目代表了在讨论更换电缆时同时探讨的可能的第四条电缆增容方案，包括评估无功支持需求的必要性。

sents.en: MISO’s 3,000/2,500 MW constraints represent the physical regional directional transfer limits, separately from the auction’s subregional import/export allowances.
sents.zh: MISO 的 3,000/2,500 MW 约束代表该地区实际的方向性传输物理极限，与拍卖中的次区域进口/出口额度是分开的。

sents.en: South African corridor counts and the 31 TDP candidates are study aggregations of GIS records and planned lines; expected in-service years determine eligibility under the study’s stated rule.
sents.zh: 南非的走廊数量和 31 个 TDP 候选项目是对 GIS 记录和规划线路的研究汇总；预期投运年份根据该研究所述规则决定其入选资格。

sents.en: Australia’s archived nominal interconnector capabilities are held fixed, although realized capability depends on operating conditions.
sents.zh: 澳大利亚归档的标称联络线容量保持固定不变，尽管实际容量取决于运行条件。

sents.en: New Zealand’s 1,400 MW candidate represents the possible fourth-cable enhancement discussed alongside cable replacement, including the need to assess reactive support.
sents.zh: 新西兰的 1,400 MW 候选项目代表了在讨论更换电缆时同时探讨的可能的第四条电缆增容方案，包括评估无功支持需求的必要性。

paragraphs.en: The representative feeders are calibrated so that bare peak load gives approximately 0.96 per unit on the 12.47 kV US feeder and 0.98 per unit on the 22 kV South African feeder. Demand, photovoltaic output, and existing and new battery operation are mapped to those circuits. Line-current limits are 400 A for the normal circuit and 600 A for the reinforced circuit.
paragraphs.zh: 代表性馈线经过标定，使得无负载削峰时峰值负荷在 12.47 kV 美国馈线上约为 0.96 标幺值，在 22 kV 南非馈线上约为 0.98 标幺值。 需求、光伏出力以及现有和新增电池的运行均被映射到这些线路上。 普通线路的线路电流限制为 400 A，加强线路的线路电流限制为 600 A。

sents.en: The representative feeders are calibrated so that bare peak load gives approximately 0.96 per unit on the 12.47 kV US feeder and 0.98 per unit on the 22 kV South African feeder.
sents.zh: 代表性馈线经过标定，使得无负载削峰时峰值负荷在 12.47 kV 美国馈线上约为 0.96 标幺值，在 22 kV 南非馈线上约为 0.98 标幺值。

sents.en: Demand, photovoltaic output, and existing and new battery operation are mapped to those circuits.
sents.zh: 需求、光伏出力以及现有和新增电池的运行均被映射到这些线路上。

sents.en: Line-current limits are 400 A for the normal circuit and 600 A for the reinforced circuit.
sents.zh: 普通线路的线路电流限制为 400 A，加强线路的线路电流限制为 600 A。

paragraphs.en: The carbon-constrained geographic figures read retained committed candidates without new inference, optimization or power-flow simulation. Each of the ten system–year scenarios displays its minimum observed accepted-cost portfolio across the four deployment–architecture trajectories. GPT-6.1 Sol single-agent supplies the representative in all ten scenarios, with tied minima identified explicitly. The carbon maps show model-zone additions and schematic connections. The main figure displays the latest evaluated year in each of the five systems, while the atlas retains all ten system–year scenarios. Capacity-pie area increases with added generation and battery power, subject to a minimum visible area. For each model zone z z , annual emissions are E z = 10 − 6 ∑ g : bus ⁡ ( g ) = z ϵ g ∑ t p g , t Δ t E_{z}=10^{-6}\sum_{g:\,\mathrm{bus}(g)=z}\epsilon_{g}\sum_{t}p_{g,t}\Delta t , calculated from the retained accepted dispatch and checked by summing the zonal values back to the reported system total. Fixed-size emissions circles share a logarithmic scale from 0.01 to 200 Mt per year; smaller positive values receive the minimum colour and zero values are hollow. This is generation-based direct operational accounting, not consumption-based allocation, lifecycle accounting or measured plant-level emissions. The budget applies to the system total rather than individual zones.
paragraphs.zh: 受碳约束的地理图在不进行新的推断、优化或潮流仿真的情况下，保留了已承诺的候选智能体。 十个系统—年份情景中的每一个都展示了其在四条部署—架构轨迹上观测到的最小可接受成本组合。 GPT-6.1 Sol 单智能体在全部十个情景中提供代表值，并列的最小值被明确标出。 碳排放地图显示了模型区域的新增部分及示意图式的连接。 主图展示五个系统中各自最新评估的年份，而图集保留了全部十个系统—年份情景。 容量饼图的面积随新增发电和电池功率而增大，但受最小可见面积的限制。 对于每个模型区域 z z ，年排放量为 E z = 10 − 6 ∑ g : bus ⁡ ( g ) = z ϵ g ∑ t p g , t Δ t E_{z}=10^{-6}\sum_{g:\,\mathrm{bus}(g)=z}\epsilon_{g}\sum_{t}p_{g,t}\Delta t ，由保留的可接受调度结果计算得出，并通过将各区域数值加总与报告的系统总量进行核对。 固定大小的排放圆圈共享一个从每年 0.01 到 200 Mt 的对数刻度；较小的正值采用最低颜色，零值为空心。 这是基于发电侧的直接运营核算，而非基于消费的分配、生命周期核算或实测的电厂级排放。 该预算适用于系统总量而非单个区域。

sents.en: The carbon-constrained geographic figures read retained committed candidates without new inference, optimization or power-flow simulation.
sents.zh: 受碳约束的地理图在不进行新的推断、优化或潮流仿真的情况下，保留了已承诺的候选智能体。

sents.en: Each of the ten system–year scenarios displays its minimum observed accepted-cost portfolio across the four deployment–architecture trajectories.
sents.zh: 十个系统—年份情景中的每一个都展示了其在四条部署—架构轨迹上观测到的最小可接受成本组合。

sents.en: GPT-6.1 Sol single-agent supplies the representative in all ten scenarios, with tied minima identified explicitly.
sents.zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 单智能体在全部十个情景中提供代表值，并列的最小值被明确标出。

sents.en: The carbon maps show model-zone additions and schematic connections.

sents.zh: 主图展示五个系统中各自最新评估的年份，而图集保留了全部十个系统—年份情景。

sents.en: Capacity-pie area increases with added generation and battery power, subject to a minimum visible area.
sents.zh: 容量饼图的面积随新增发电和电池功率而增大，但受最小可见面积的限制。

sents.en: For each model zone z z , annual emissions are E z = 10 − 6 ∑ g : bus ⁡ ( g ) = z ϵ g ∑ t p g , t Δ t E_{z}=10^{-6}\sum_{g:\,\mathrm{bus}(g)=z}\epsilon_{g}\sum_{t}p_{g,t}\Delta t , calculated from the retained accepted dispatch and checked by summing the zonal values back to the reported system total.
sents.zh: 对于每个模型区域 z z ，年排放量为 E z = 10 − 6 ∑ g : bus ⁡ ( g ) = z ϵ g ∑ t p g , t Δ t E_{z}=10^{-6}\sum_{g:\,\mathrm{bus}(g)=z}\epsilon_{g}\sum_{t}p_{g,t}\Delta t ，由保留的可接受调度结果计算得出，并通过将各区域数值加总与报告的系统总量进行核对。

sents.en: Fixed-size emissions circles share a logarithmic scale from 0.01 to 200 Mt per year; smaller positive values receive the minimum colour and zero values are hollow.

sents.en: This is generation-based direct operational accounting, not consumption-based allocation, lifecycle accounting or measured plant-level emissions.
sents.zh: 这是基于发电侧的直接运营核算，而非基于消费的分配、生命周期核算或实测的电厂级排放。

sents.en: The budget applies to the system total rather than individual zones.
sents.zh: 该预算适用于系统总量而非单个区域。

paragraphs.en: The reference figures 1 and 2 read committed candidates without new inference, optimization or power-flow simulation. Figure 1 and Appendix 9 select the minimum observed accepted 2035 cost across the four deployment–architecture trajectories per system; tied minima retain the displayed representative. Figure 2 separately follows the Opus multi-agent ERCOT 2035 repair trajectory. New and inherited capacity totals are aggregated from the retained asset records by model node. Added transfer capacity sums selected generic-circuit and official-project increments on each model corridor.
paragraphs.zh: 参考图1和图2读取已提交的候选方案，不进行新的推理、优化或潮流仿真。 图1和附录9针对每个系统，选取四条部署—架构轨迹中观察到的最小已接受2035年成本；并列的最小值保留所示代表性方案。 图2单独跟踪Opus多智能体ERCOT 2035修复轨迹。 新增与继承的容量合计按模型节点从保留的资产记录中汇总。 新增输电容量在每个模型走廊上汇总所选通用线路与官方项目的增量。

sents.en: The reference figures 1 and 2 read committed candidates without new inference, optimization or power-flow simulation.
sents.zh: 参考图1和图2读取已提交的候选方案，不进行新的推理、优化或潮流仿真。

sents.en: Figure 1 and Appendix 9 select the minimum observed accepted 2035 cost across the four deployment–architecture trajectories per system; tied minima retain the displayed representative.
sents.zh: 图1和附录9针对每个系统，选取四条部署—架构轨迹中观察到的最小已接受2035年成本；并列的最小值保留所示代表性方案。

sents.en: Figure 2 separately follows the Opus multi-agent ERCOT 2035 repair trajectory.
sents.zh: 图2单独跟踪Opus多智能体ERCOT 2035修复轨迹。

sents.en: New and inherited capacity totals are aggregated from the retained asset records by model node.
sents.zh: 新增与继承的容量合计按模型节点从保留的资产记录中汇总。

sents.en: Added transfer capacity sums selected generic-circuit and official-project increments on each model corridor.
sents.zh: 新增输电容量在每个模型走廊上汇总所选通用线路与官方项目的增量。

paragraphs.en: Natural Earth version 5.1.1, at 1:50 million scale, supplies public-domain country and US state boundaries [ 22 ] ; each panel uses a local Lambert azimuthal equal-area projection. Model-node coordinates come from the prepared regional input packs. They represent grouped-zone centroids, administrative proxies or reference cities, as recorded for each node. In the reference figures, US operating-plant points join the archived 2023 inventory (status OP) to plant coordinates and are deduplicated by plant code. The other five systems use model-zone coordinates. New capacity is allocated by zone, and model connections are drawn as straight schematic corridors.
paragraphs.zh: Natural Earth 5.1.1 版本、比例尺为 1:50 百万，提供了公有领域的国家与美国州界数据 [ 22 ]；每个图幅均采用局部兰伯特方位等积投影。 模型节点坐标来自制备好的区域输入包。 它们代表分组区域质心、行政代理点或参考城市，正如每个节点所记录的那样。 在参考图中，美国运行电厂点与归档的 2023 年清单（状态为 OP）以及电厂坐标相连，并按电厂代码去重。 其余五个系统使用模型区域坐标。 新增容量按区域分配，模型连接绘制为直线示意走廊。

sents.en: Natural Earth version 5.1.1, at 1:50 million scale, supplies public-domain country and US state boundaries [ 22 ] ; each panel uses a local Lambert azimuthal equal-area projection.
sents.zh: Natural Earth 5.1.1 版本、比例尺为 1:50 百万，提供了公有领域的国家与美国州界数据 [ 22 ]；每个图幅均采用局部兰伯特方位等积投影。

sents.en: Model-node coordinates come from the prepared regional input packs.
sents.zh: 模型节点坐标来自制备好的区域输入包。

sents.en: They represent grouped-zone centroids, administrative proxies or reference cities, as recorded for each node.
sents.zh: 它们代表分组区域质心、行政代理点或参考城市，正如每个节点所记录的那样。

sents.en: In the reference figures, US operating-plant points join the archived 2023 inventory (status OP) to plant coordinates and are deduplicated by plant code.
sents.zh: 在参考图中，美国运行电厂点与归档的 2023 年清单（状态为 OP）以及电厂坐标相连，并按电厂代码去重。

sents.en: The other five systems use model-zone coordinates.
sents.zh: 其余五个系统使用模型区域坐标。

sents.en: New capacity is allocated by zone, and model connections are drawn as straight schematic corridors.
sents.zh: 新增容量按区域分配，模型连接绘制为直线示意走廊。

paragraphs.en: The reference ERCOT verification panels use annual extrema, currents, ratings and violation counts already committed in the initial and selected Far West representative-feeder outputs. Endpoint colours show annual feeder voltage extrema; line colours show annual per-line peak current divided by the corresponding candidate’s rating. Extrema may occur at different hours. The stylized three-bus circuit depicts the numerical feeder topology. A frozen geographic evidence file and SHA-256 source manifest record all extracted values, coordinate files and basemap archives.
paragraphs.zh: 参考 ERCOT 校验面板使用已在初始和选定 Far West 代表性馈线输出中提交的年度极值、电流、额定值和违规计数。 端点颜色表示年度馈线电压极值；线路颜色表示年度每条线路峰值电流除以对应候选方案的额定值。 极值可能出现在不同时刻。 风格化的三母线电路图描述了数值馈线拓扑。 冻结的地理证据文件和 SHA-256 源清单记录了所有提取的数值、坐标文件和底图存档。

sents.en: The reference ERCOT verification panels use annual extrema, currents, ratings and violation counts already committed in the initial and selected Far West representative-feeder outputs.
sents.zh: 参考 ERCOT 校验面板使用已在初始和选定 Far West 代表性馈线输出中提交的年度极值、电流、额定值和违规计数。

sents.en: Endpoint colours show annual feeder voltage extrema; line colours show annual per-line peak current divided by the corresponding candidate’s rating.
sents.zh: 端点颜色表示年度馈线电压极值；线路颜色表示年度每条线路峰值电流除以对应候选方案的额定值。

sents.en: Extrema may occur at different hours.
sents.zh: 极值可能出现在不同时刻。

sents.en: The stylized three-bus circuit depicts the numerical feeder topology.
sents.zh: 风格化的三母线电路图描述了数值馈线拓扑。

sents.en: A frozen geographic evidence file and SHA-256 source manifest record all extracted values, coordinate files and basemap archives.
sents.zh: 冻结的地理证据文件和 SHA-256 源清单记录了所有提取的数值、坐标文件和底图存档。

paragraphs.en: Existing generation and storage retain their locations and capacities while dispatch and additional investment are optimized. Historical construction costs are treated as sunk; specified existing fixed costs and operating costs remain included. The model represents one planning year with exogenous demand. Each demand area has one representative bus with hourly load, photovoltaic and wind profiles.
paragraphs.zh: 现有发电与储能设施保留其位置和容量，同时对调度和新增投资进行优化。 历史建设成本被视为沉没成本；指定的既有固定成本和运行成本仍然包含在内。 该模型表示一个具有外生需求的规划年度。 每个需求区域都有一个代表性母线，包含逐时的负荷、光伏和风电出力曲线。

sents.en: Existing generation and storage retain their locations and capacities while dispatch and additional investment are optimized.
sents.zh: 现有发电与储能设施保留其位置和容量，同时对调度和新增投资进行优化。

sents.en: Historical construction costs are treated as sunk; specified existing fixed costs and operating costs remain included.
sents.zh: 历史建设成本被视为沉没成本；指定的既有固定成本和运行成本仍然包含在内。

sents.en: The model represents one planning year with exogenous demand.
sents.zh: 该模型表示一个具有外生需求的规划年度。

sents.en: Each demand area has one representative bus with hourly load, photovoltaic and wind profiles.
sents.zh: 每个需求区域都有一个代表性母线，包含逐时的负荷、光伏和风电出力曲线。

paragraphs.en: Inter-area transmission uses a zonal transport formulation. Each corridor is represented by directed links with published or declared capacity and a wheeling cost of 0.1 USD/MWh. Published multi-path limits enter as cut-set constraints, while zonal import and export limits constrain net nodal interchange. Candidate circuits and official projects are binary build decisions. An investment raises the constraints it crosses by a published increment or a declared capacity assumption. Equivalent project choices are ordered to remove symmetric branches without changing the set of feasible networks.
paragraphs.zh: 区域间输电采用分区输运公式进行建模。 每条走廊由有向链路表示，具有已公布或申明的容量，以及 0.1 美元/兆瓦时的过网输电费。 已公布的多路径限制以割集约束的形式引入，而分区进口和出口限制则约束节点的净交换量。 候选线路和官方项目均为二元建设决策。 一项投资会使其所跨越的约束按已公布的增量或申明的容量假设得到提升。 等价的项目选择被排序，以消除对称分支，同时不改变可行网络集合。

paragraphs.en: Acceptance requires a valid solver solution, unmet energy below 10 − 4 10^{-4} of demand, passing voltage, convergence and thermal checks at every representative feeder, and nodal, storage and interface residuals within the declared tolerances. For the primary cohort, a separate carbon-budget audit checks finite reported emissions, the fixed scenario and result ceilings, source identity and the 8,760-hour horizon. The emissions reporting tolerance is max ⁡ ( 10 − 9 , 10 − 8 ​ B r , y ) \max(10^{-9},10^{-8}B_{r,y}) Mt, and does not relax the optimizer’s budget. Gurobi uses eighteen threads, a barrier root relaxation, a requested relative MIP gap of 0.1% and a 24-hour ceiling per solve [ 41 ] . Each numerical cost interval spans the solver bound and incumbent objective for the candidate’s fixed optimization domain, with the selected distribution cost added to both endpoints. Unserved energy is penalized at v = 50,000 ​ USD / MWh v=50{,}000\ \mathrm{USD}/\mathrm{MWh} and checked against the acceptance threshold after optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 验收要求：求解器给出有效解、未满足能量低于需求的 10^{-4}、每个代表性馈线均通过电压、收敛与热校验，且节点、储能与接口残差处于声明的容差范围内。 对于主队列，另有一项碳预算审计，检查报告排放量是否有限、固定的情景与结果上限、来源身份以及 8,760 小时的时间范围。 排放报告容差为 max(10^{-9}, 10^{-8}B_{r,y}) Mt，且不会放宽优化器的预算。 Gurobi 使用十八个线程、障碍法根松弛、0.1% 的请求相对 MIP 间隙，以及每次求解 24 小时的上限 [41]。 每个数值成本区间覆盖候选方案固定优化域的求解器下界与当前目标值，并将选定的配电成本加到两个端点上。 未满足能量以 v=50,000 USD/MWh 的价格进行惩罚，并在优化后对照验收阈值进行检查。

paragraphs.en: Ten researcher-selected system–year scenarios adopt annual emissions ceilings from archived official policy and planning sources (Table 5 ). We restricted the carbon-constrained evaluation to system–year pairs with a documented mapping from an official electricity-sector emissions budget or pathway to an annual model ceiling, excluding cases such as MISO 2023 and Mexico 2035. These ceilings are implemented through the existing operational_co2_budget constraint. The original input packs remain unchanged on disk, and a fixed scenario overlay records the source value, unit conversion, mapping assumptions and content hashes. The baseline policy mode leaves this independent constraint active. Agents can revise design variables but cannot alter the budget, its source identity or the acceptance requirements. The official sources determine the scenario ceilings, whereas achieved emissions are calculated from optimized dispatch and the declared inventory coefficients.
paragraphs.zh: 十个由研究者选取的系统—年份情景采用来自存档官方政策与规划文件的年度排放上限（表 5）。 我们将碳约束评估限定于具有从官方电力部门排放预算或路径到年度模型上限的书面映射关系的系统—年份组合，排除了诸如 MISO 2023 和墨西哥 2035 的情形。 这些上限通过现有的 operational_co2_budget 约束来实现。 原始输入包在磁盘上保持不变，一个固定的情景叠加层记录了来源数值、单位换算、映射假设以及内容哈希。 基线政策模式使该独立约束保持生效。 智能体可以修改设计变量，但不能更改预算、其来源标识或验收要求。 官方来源决定了情景上限，而实际排放则由优化调度和所声明的清单系数计算得出。

paragraphs.en: NYISO uses New York’s RGGI base allowance budgets as model-wide annual ceilings. US short tons are converted to metric tonnes using the exact multiplier 0.90718474. Regulated-unit coverage, interstate allowance trading, banking, reserve supply and multiyear compliance are not recreated. MISO combines the 2025 Future 2 aggregate planning emissions constraint with the 2026 LTLF Current Trajectory demand inputs. South Africa combines the IRP 2025 balanced-plan emissions pathway with ESRG spatialized reference demand excluding exports. These combinations preserve the published source values without claiming to reproduce each official scenario in full.
paragraphs.zh: NYISO 将纽约州的 RGGI 基础配额预算用作全模型范围的年度上限。 美制短吨使用精确系数 0.90718474 换算为公吨。 受管制机组的覆盖范围、跨州配额交易、配额储备、储备供应以及多年期合规机制均未重现。 MISO 将 2025 年 Future 2 汇总规划排放约束与 2026 年 LTLF 当前轨迹需求输入相结合。 南非将 IRP 2025 平衡方案的排放路径与不含出口的 ESRG 空间化参考需求相结合。 这些组合保留了已发布的源数据数值，但不声称完整重现每个官方情景。

paragraphs.en: Mexico adopts the PROSENER 2030 electricity-emissions projection, combining it with the existing PRODESEN demand inputs. The model excludes SIMUL/Mulege and does not infer a proportional emissions allocation to that excluded subsystem. Brazil uses the PDE 2035 SIN projection, corresponding to the model’s four interconnected subsystems, rather than the larger whole-sector projection. The Brazilian plan reports these quantities as projected outcomes rather than imposed emissions limits, and its average-hydrology assumption differs from the model’s inherited hydro-energy assumptions. Mexico and Brazil report CO 2 -equivalent emissions. We adopt their numerical values as direct CO 2 ceilings as an explicit proxy, without converting between greenhouse gases. Exact document locations and source-to-model assumptions are preserved in the carbon-scenario archive.
paragraphs.zh: 墨西哥采用 PROSENER 2030 电力排放预测，并将其与现有的 PRODESEN 需求输入相结合。 该模型排除了 SIMUL/Mulege，且不会推断该被排除子系统按比例分配的排放量。 巴西采用 PDE 2035 SIN 预测，该预测对应于模型的四个互联子系统，而非更大的全部门预测。 巴西的规划将这些数量报告为预测结果而非强制排放上限，且其平均水文假设与模型继承的水电能源假设不同。 墨西哥和巴西报告的是二氧化碳当量排放。 我们将其数值直接作为二氧化碳上限采用，作为一种明确的代理方式，不在温室气体之间进行换算。 确切的文档位置以及从数据源到模型的假设均保存在碳情景存档中。

paragraphs.en: Photovoltaic capacity factors use the PVWatts v8 model through PySAM [ 42 , 43 ] . Baseline profiles use ERA5 from the Open-Meteo historical archive, including global, direct-normal and diffuse irradiance, temperature and 100 m wind speed [ 44 , 45 ] . Arrays are fixed racks facing the equator, with tilt equal to absolute latitude, a DC-to-AC ratio of one and 14% losses. Radiation averages are aligned to the load-interval start. The same conversion settings are applied to reconstructed future weather.
paragraphs.zh: 光伏容量系数通过 PySAM 使用 PVWatts v8 模型 [ 42 , 43 ]。 基线廓线使用来自 Open-Meteo 历史档案的 ERA5 数据，包括全球水平、直接法向和散射辐照度、温度以及 100 米风速 [ 44 , 45 ]。 光伏阵列采用朝向赤道的固定支架，倾角等于纬度的绝对值，直流交流比为 1，损失为 14%。 辐照度平均值与负荷区间起点对齐。 相同的转换设置应用于重建的未来天气。

sents.en: Photovoltaic capacity factors use the PVWatts v8 model through PySAM [ 42 , 43 ] .
sents.zh: 光伏容量系数通过 PySAM 使用 PVWatts v8 模型 [ 42 , 43 ]。

sents.zh: 辐照度平均值与负荷区间起点对齐。

sents.en: The same conversion settings are applied to reconstructed future weather.
sents.zh: 相同的转换设置应用于重建的未来天气。

paragraphs.en: Wind capacity factors use the archived 2020 ATB NREL reference turbine curve, rated at 4 MW with a 150 m rotor [ 46 ] . For the ERA5-weather evaluation, each node’s ERA5 100 m wind-speed series feeds this curve directly. The same reference curve is used across regions, while the node-specific weather produces distinct hourly resource profiles.
paragraphs.zh: 风电容量系数采用存档的 2020 年 ATB 中 NREL 参考风机功率曲线，额定功率为 4 MW，风轮直径为 150 m [ 46 ] 。 在 ERA5 天气评估中，每个节点的 ERA5 100 米风速序列直接输入该曲线。 同一参考曲线在各区域通用，而各节点特定的天气产生了不同的逐小时资源曲线。

EIA-930 bulk-system delivery and the South African sent-out demand include distribution losses in their accounting basis. paragraphs.en: US electricity-technology costs are derived from the locally archived 2024 ATB version 4, using the Market financing case, Moderate scenario and 2030 technology values with a 30-year cost-recovery period [ 36 ] . The battery power and energy coefficients are fitted from the available duration-specific products using the derivation script. South African technology costs and the hydrogen chain use archived PyPSA technology-data inputs [ 37 ] ; Australia, New Zealand, Mexico and Brazil use the declared ATB electricity-cost basis in US dollars. Annualization assumptions and per-value provenance are retained in the derived cost JSON files.
paragraphs.zh: 美国电力技术成本来自本地存档的 2024 年 ATB 第 4 版，采用 Market 融资情景、Moderate 情景以及 2030 年技术数值，成本回收期为 30 年 [ 36 ] 。 电池功率与能量系数通过推导脚本从可用的按持续时间分类的产品中拟合得到。 南非的技术成本和氢能链条使用存档的 PyPSA 技术数据输入 [ 37 ] ；澳大利亚、新西兰、墨西哥和巴西使用以美元计的已声明 ATB 电力成本基准。 年度化假设及每个数值的来源信息保留在推导得到的成本 JSON 文件中。

paragraphs.en: New batteries use charging and discharging efficiencies of 0.95 each; existing pumped storage and other storage use declared round-trip efficiencies. Storage is cyclic over the simulated horizon. Hydrogen is represented by an electrolyzer link, an energy store on a hydrogen bus and a fuel-cell link with independently extendable capacities. New nuclear is an extendable generator with a minimum output of 70% of installed capacity; existing nuclear is dispatched flexibly. Existing thermal, hydro and biomass fleets are fixed generators with declared availability, marginal cost and emission rate, and hydro and concentrating solar carry annual energy budgets. Historical construction costs of existing assets are sunk; declared annual fixed costs remain in the objective. The primary cohort uses the scenario-specific annual CO 2 budgets in Table 5 ; the reference archive retains the original 1,000 Mt annual ceiling.
paragraphs.zh: 新电池采用充放电效率均为 0.95；既有抽水蓄能及其他储能采用声明的往返效率。 储能在模拟时间范围内循环运行。 氢能由一个电解槽链路、氢气母线上的储能装置以及一个燃料电池链路表示，三者的容量均可独立扩展。 新建核电是可扩展的发电机，最小出力为装机容量的 70%；既有核电则灵活调度。 既有的火电、水电和生物质机组组是固定发电机，具有声明的可用率、边际成本和排放率，其中水电和光热发电带有年度能量预算。 既有资产的历史建设成本为沉没成本；声明的年度固定成本仍计入目标函数。 主要队列使用表 5 中针对具体情景的年度 CO 2 预算；参考存档保留原来的 1,000 Mt 年度上限。

paragraphs.en: The representative feeder has a source bus, two serial line segments and two loads allocated 40% and 60% of feeder demand, with photovoltaic generation at the downstream bus and battery charging and discharging split between the two buses by a design variable. Both loads use a nominal power factor of 0.95. US feeders are 12.47 kV with 2 km sections and South African feeders 22 kV with 3 km sections, at 0.25 and 0.33 ohm/km; these lengths were calibrated so that the bare peak load sits inside the band. A node’s demand is mapped to a 5 MW feeder at the node’s peak, with photovoltaic and battery dispatch mapped by the same share. Hourly photovoltaic injection and battery power follow the optimized system dispatch.
paragraphs.zh: 该典型馈线包含一个源母线、两段串联线路段以及两个负荷，负荷分别分配馈线需求的 40% 和 60%，下游母线处设有光伏发电，而电池的充放电则通过一个设计变量在两条母线之间分配。 两个负荷均采用 0.95 的额定功率因数。 美国馈线为 12.47 kV、2 km 的线段，南非馈线为 22 kV、3 km 的线段，阻抗分别为 0.25 和 0.33 欧姆/km；这些长度经过校准，使得裸峰值负荷落在该区间内。 节点的需求按其峰值映射到一条 5 MW 馈线，光伏和电池出力按相同比例映射。 每小时的光伏注入功率和电池功率遵循优化后的系统调度。

paragraphs.en: At each hour, OpenDSS solves a snapshot and returns bus-voltage magnitudes and line currents. The acceptance band is 0.95–1.05 per unit, non-convergent hours count as failures, and line currents are checked against 400 A normal and 600 A reinforced ratings. If reactive control is enabled and the initial maximum exceeds 1.03 per unit, the photovoltaic generator absorbs reactive power at the configured 0.95 power factor and the hour is solved again. The line-upgrade intervention halves line impedance and raises the rating. Its annualized cost is the configured per-feeder cost multiplied by
paragraphs.zh: 在每个小时，OpenDSS 求解一次快照并返回母线电压幅值和线路电流。 合格区间为 0.95–1.05 标幺值，不收敛的小时计为失败，线路电流按 400 A 正常额定值和 600 A 加固额定值进行检查。 如果启用了无功控制且初始最大值超过 1.03 标幺值，光伏发电机将按配置的 0.95 功率因数吸收无功功率，并重新求解该小时。 线路升级干预会将线路阻抗减半并提高额定值。 其年化成本为配置的每条馈线成本乘以

sents.en: The acceptance band is 0.95–1.05 per unit, non-convergent hours count as failures, and line currents are checked against 400 A normal and 600 A reinforced ratings.

sents.zh: 线路升级干预会将线路阻抗减半并提高额定值。

sents.en: Its annualized cost is the configured per-feeder cost multiplied by
sents.zh: 其年化成本为配置的每条馈线成本乘以

paragraphs.en: with system demand in MW and feeder peak power in kW. This representative-circuit replication scales intervention costs with each zone’s peak demand. Distribution controls are evaluated on the retained system dispatch using OpenDSS steady-state snapshots [ 17 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 其中系统需求以 MW 为单位，馈线峰值功率以 kW 为单位。 这种代表性电路复制方法使干预成本与各区域的峰值需求成比例缩放。 配电控制在使用 OpenDSS 稳态快照的保留系统调度上进行评估 [ 17 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Demand inputs comprise eight regional packs for each of 2023, 2030 and 2035. Forecast editions published in 2024–2026 determine the target-year scale, and each pack supplies the same demand to both architectures. Table 6 reports annual energy and growth relative to 2023. Demand year, resource-weather source and hourly-template year are recorded separately. Reported cases pair 2023 demand with ERA5 2023 resources and future demand with the matching NASA projection year. The ERA5 2023 hourly template supplies intraday shape for future resources, not their projection year.
paragraphs.zh: 需求输入包括2023年、2030年和2035年各自的八套区域数据包。 2024至2026年发布的预测版本决定目标年规模，且每个数据包向两种架构提供相同的需求。 表6报告了相对于2023年的年度电量和增长率。 需求年份、资源气象数据来源和小时模板年份分别记录。 所报告的案例将2023年需求与ERA5 2023资源配对，将未来需求与对应的NASA预测年份配对。 ERA5 2023小时模板为未来资源提供日内形状，而非其预测年份。

sents.zh: 需求输入包括2023年、2030年和2035年各自的八套区域数据包。

sents.en: Forecast editions published in 2024–2026 determine the target-year scale, and each pack supplies the same demand to both architectures.

sents.en: Table 6 reports annual energy and growth relative to 2023.
sents.zh: 表6报告了相对于2023年的年度电量和增长率。

paragraphs.en: MISO uses the Current Trajectory annual net-load forecast in the 2026 Long-Term Load Forecast regional supplementary workbook. Its ten local resource zones are aggregated into the six model groups. ERCOT uses the 2025 ERCOT-adjusted hourly Long-Term Load Forecast; the eight weather-zone net-load columns are summed over each target year to obtain annual energy. NYISO uses the eleven zonal annual-energy values in Table I-2 of the 2026 Gold Book Baseline Forecast Tables. Mexico uses the planning-scenario net-consumption values in Table 3.5 of SENER’s PRODESEN 2024–2038 for the nine modelled control areas. Brazil uses the reference-scenario subsystem loads in Table 2-3 of the 2026 final report of PDE 2035. Each value in average MW is multiplied by 8,760 hours and divided by 1,000 to obtain GWh for the four model subsystems.
paragraphs.zh: MISO 使用 2026 年长期负荷预测区域补充工作簿中的当前轨迹年净负荷预测。 其十个本地资源区被聚合为六个模型组。 ERCOT 使用 2025 年经 ERCOT 调整的小时级长期负荷预测；将八个天气区的净负荷列按每个目标年份求和，得到年电量。 NYISO 使用 2026 年 Gold Book 基线预测表表 I-2 中的十一个分区年电量值。 墨西哥使用 SENER《PRODESEN 2024–2038》表 3.5 中九个受建模控制区的规划情景净消费值。 巴西使用 PDE 2035 年 2026 年最终报告表 2-3 中参考情景的子系统负荷。 每个以平均兆瓦（MW）表示的数值乘以 8,760 小时再除以 1,000，得到四个模型子系统的 GWh。

paragraphs.en: South Africa uses the University of Cape Town ESRG Hourly Demand Model v2025 by Province and its spatialized IRP REF series, with exports excluded. The source’s hourly model outputs are summed over each target year separately for the ten supply areas to obtain E z , y E_{z,y} . Equation 8 maps those annual targets onto the corresponding prepared 2023 templates. Both the baseline and future inputs retain the source’s status as spatially allocated model outputs informed by national demand projections and regional calibration data.
paragraphs.zh: 南非采用开普敦大学 ESRG 省级小时需求模型 v2025 及其空间化的 IRP REF 序列，并剔除出口部分。 将该来源小时模型的输出按每个目标年份分别对十个供电区域求和，得到 E z , y E_{z,y}。 公式 8 将这些年度目标映射到相应的已准备的 2023 年模板上。 基准年输入和未来输入均保留该来源作为空间分配模型输出的性质，这些输出基于全国需求预测和区域校准数据。

sents.zh: 基准年输入和未来输入均保留该来源作为空间分配模型输出的性质，这些输出基于全国需求预测和区域校准数据。

paragraphs.en: Demand totals retain the source assumptions about electrification, industrial activity and large loads, including NYISO’s large-load tables, AEMO’s data-centre outlook and Transpower’s DataGrid step-load assumptions. The 2023 evaluation uses ERA5 2023 resource profiles; the future packs use the corresponding target-year NASA profiles described below. All cases retain the inherited fleet, baseline policy and ATB/PyPSA technology-cost basis [ 36 , 37 ] . The primary evaluation applies its fixed carbon-budget overlay independently of this policy mode. Each target year is a single-period brownfield problem, and representative-feeder replication follows the scenario peak.
paragraphs.zh: 需求总量保留了源数据关于电气化、工业活动和大负荷的假设，包括 NYISO 的大负荷表格、AEMO 的数据中心展望以及 Transpower 的 DataGrid 阶跃负荷假设。 2023 年评估使用 ERA5 2023 年资源曲线；未来数据包使用下文所述的相应目标年份 NASA 曲线。 所有情景均保留继承的机组群、基准政策以及 ATB/PyPSA 技术成本基础 [ 36 , 37 ] 。 主评估独立于该政策模式应用其固定的碳预算叠加层。 每个目标年份都是一个单周期棕地问题，代表性馈线的复制遵循情景峰值。

sents.en: Demand totals retain the source assumptions about electrification, industrial activity and large loads, including NYISO’s large-load tables, AEMO’s data-centre outlook and Transpower’s DataGrid step-load assumptions.
sents.zh: 需求总量保留了源数据关于电气化、工业活动和大负荷的假设，包括 NYISO 的大负荷表格、AEMO 的数据中心展望以及 Transpower 的 DataGrid 阶跃负荷假设。

sents.en: Each target year is a single-period brownfield problem, and representative-feeder replication follows the scenario peak.
sents.zh: 每个目标年份都是一个单周期棕地问题，代表性馈线的复制遵循情景峰值。

paragraphs.en: South African 2030 cases apply commissioning-year eligibility to the official transmission projects in the NTCSA Transmission Development Plan. A project is eligible when its documented in-service year is at or before 2030; an indivisible project with a date range uses the final year. Other region–year routes retain their inherited project permissions. Generic candidate-circuit expansion follows the declared circuit bounds.
paragraphs.zh: 南非2030情形对NTCSA输电发展规划中的官方输电项目适用投运年资格规则。 当项目的文件在役年份不晚于2030年时，该项目即具备资格；对于日期为一个区间且不可分割的项目，则采用其最后一年。 其他地区-年份路径保留其继承的项目权限。 通用候选线路扩展遵循所声明的线路边界。

sents.en: South African 2030 cases apply commissioning-year eligibility to the official transmission projects in the NTCSA Transmission Development Plan.
sents.zh: 南非2030情形对NTCSA输电发展规划中的官方输电项目适用投运年资格规则。

sents.en: A project is eligible when its documented in-service year is at or before 2030; an indivisible project with a date range uses the final year.
sents.zh: 当项目的文件在役年份不晚于2030年时，该项目即具备资格；对于日期为一个区间且不可分割的项目，则采用其最后一年。

sents.en: Other region–year routes retain their inherited project permissions.
sents.zh: 其他地区-年份路径保留其继承的项目权限。

sents.en: Generic candidate-circuit expansion follows the declared circuit bounds.

paragraphs.en: Preparation records source editions, scenarios, extraction coordinates, geographic mappings, unit conversions and file hashes. Demand checks confirm 8,760 finite non-negative values per zone, agreement with annual-energy targets and identical inputs across architectures.
