paragraphs.en: For the combined input library, we prepared 16 future-weather input packs covering eight systems in 2030 and 2035, comprising 116 annual node profiles. The primary cohort uses nine of these future system–year packs. NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 v2.0 supplies daily, bias-corrected projections at 0.25 ∘ 0.25^{\circ} resolution [ 47 , 48 ] . The selected realization is MPI-ESM1-2-HR, member r1i1p1f1, under SSP2-4.5. At each of the 58 representative locations, we selected the nearest grid cell with complete records for all four variables, comprising minimum and maximum temperature ( tasmin , tasmax ; K), daily-mean shortwave irradiance ( rsds ; W m -2 ) and near-surface wind speed ( sfcWind ; m s -1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于合并输入库，我们准备了16个未来天气输入包，覆盖2030年和2035年的八个系统，共包含116份年度节点概况。 主要队列使用其中的九个未来系统—年份包。 NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 v2.0 提供0.25 ∘ 0.25^{\circ} 分辨率的逐日偏差校正预估数据 [ 47 , 48 ] 。 选定的实现为 SSP2-4.5 情景下的 MPI-ESM1-2-HR，成员 r1i1p1f1。 在58个代表性位置中的每一处，我们选取了对全部四个变量均具有完整记录的最近网格单元，这四个变量包括最低和最高气温（ tasmin ， tasmax ；K）、逐日平均短波辐照度（ rsds ；W m -2 ）以及近地面风速（ sfcWind ；m s -1 ）。

sents.en: For the combined input library, we prepared 16 future-weather input packs covering eight systems in 2030 and 2035, comprising 116 annual node profiles.
sents.zh: 对于合并输入库，我们准备了16个未来天气输入包，覆盖2030年和2035年的八个系统，共包含116份年度节点概况。

sents.en: The primary cohort uses nine of these future system–year packs.
sents.zh: 主要队列使用其中的九个未来系统—年份包。

sents.en: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 v2.0 supplies daily, bias-corrected projections at 0.25 ∘ 0.25^{\circ} resolution [ 47 , 48 ] .
sents.zh: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 v2.0 提供0.25 ∘ 0.25^{\circ} 分辨率的逐日偏差校正预估数据 [ 47 , 48 ] 。

sents.en: The selected realization is MPI-ESM1-2-HR, member r1i1p1f1, under SSP2-4.5.
sents.zh: 选定的实现为 SSP2-4.5 情景下的 MPI-ESM1-2-HR，成员 r1i1p1f1。

sents.en: At each of the 58 representative locations, we selected the nearest grid cell with complete records for all four variables, comprising minimum and maximum temperature ( tasmin , tasmax ; K), daily-mean shortwave irradiance ( rsds ; W m -2 ) and near-surface wind speed ( sfcWind ; m s -1 ).
sents.zh: 在58个代表性位置中的每一处，我们选取了对全部四个变量均具有完整记录的最近网格单元，这四个变量包括最低和最高气温（ tasmin ， tasmax ；K）、逐日平均短波辐照度（ rsds ；W m -2 ）以及近地面风速（ sfcWind ；m s -1 ）。

paragraphs.en: Target-year daily values are combined with the corresponding month–day ERA5 2023 hourly patterns [ 44 , 45 ] . Each retrieval includes the preceding 31 December and following 1 January; their templates are 2022-12-31 and 2024-01-01. Both projection years have 365 days. Complete UTC days are reconstructed before selecting 8,760 hours using each node’s fixed model-clock offset. Solar geometry uses target-year dates and interval midpoints. The profiles retain the 2023 hourly index and inherited target-year demand values (Table 8 ).

paragraphs.en: We apply PVWatts v8 through PySAM (NREL-PySAM 7.1.1.post1 in the archived generation environment) [ 42 , 43 ] with a 1 MW DC fixed array, DC/AC ratio one, equator-facing orientation, tilt equal to absolute latitude and 14% losses as study settings. Synthetic 100 m wind supplies its wind-speed input. Photovoltaic capacity factors are AC output divided by 1 MW DC. Wind capacity factors are the interpolated NREL 4 MW, 150 m-rotor reference-curve output at synthetic 100 m wind, divided by 4 MW [ 46 ] . Checks verify daily temperature extrema, solar energy and near-surface mean wind, complete hourly profiles and preserved demand. ERA5 and NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 differ in their wind and irradiance climatology at the study locations, so mean capacity factors differ between the 2023 and future-year packs (Table 7 ). Differences between 2023 and future-year outcomes therefore combine demand growth, projected climate and the change of data product. Source, processing-code and output SHA-256 hashes accompany each pack.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 PySAM（归档发电环境中的 NREL-PySAM 7.1.1.post1）[ 42 , 43 ] 应用 PVWatts v8，研究设置为 1 MW 直流固定阵列、直交流比为一、朝向赤道、倾角等于绝对纬度以及 14% 的损耗。 合成的 100 米风速提供其风速输入。 光伏容量系数为交流输出除以 1 MW 直流。 风电容量系数为在合成 100 米风速下插值得到的 NREL 4 MW、150 米转子参考曲线输出除以 4 MW [ 46 ] 。 校验内容验证每日温度极值、太阳能能量和近地面平均风、完整的小时剖面以及保持的需求。 ERA5 与 NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 在研究地点的风和辐照度气候学上存在差异，因此 2023 年数据包与未来年份数据包之间的平均容量系数有所不同（表 7 ）。 因此，2023 年与未来年份结果之间的差异综合了需求增长、预估气候以及数据产品的变化。 每个数据包均附带源数据、处理代码和输出的 SHA-256 哈希值。

paragraphs.en: The shared action interface includes technology permissions, global and node-level capacity caps, battery duration, charging and discharging fractions, distribution reinforcement, reactive control, battery placement, candidate-circuit bounds and project permissions. These variables constrain the optimizer. Demand, weather, costs, existing assets, network assumptions, policy and the annual carbon budget are immutable through the agent interface. Code reconstructs fixed roles, tools and acceptance requirements independently of editable guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 共享行动接口包括技术权限、全局与节点级容量上限、电池持续时间、充放电比例、配电加固、无功控制、电池选址、候选线路边界和项目权限。 这些变量约束优化器。 需求、天气、成本、既有资产、网络假设、政策和年度碳预算通过智能体接口是不可更改的。 代码独立于可编辑指导来重构固定角色、工具和验收要求。

paragraphs.en: The single agent maintains a continuous conversation and free-form strategy notes. At each turn, it chooses among state inspection, design modification, system simulation, feeder rechecking, note revision and termination. The agent determines the order of these actions, subject to fixed tool preconditions. The current notes are reinserted into the system prompt at every turn, while the preceding conversation remains available.
paragraphs.zh: 单个智能体维持连续对话和自由格式的策略笔记。 在每一轮中，它可在状态检查、设计修改、系统仿真、馈线复检、笔记修订与终止之间进行选择。 智能体在满足固定的工具前置条件的前提下，决定这些动作的执行顺序。 每一轮都会将当前笔记重新插入系统提示词，同时之前的对话仍然可用。

paragraphs.en: At the start of each multi-agent cycle, four specialists in system architecture, renewable generation, storage and firm generation receive the same shared state and advisory procedure-graph guidance. They independently propose changes without access to one another’s proposals for that cycle. The orchestrator receives all four proposals and selects one experiment, which may combine proposed changes or retain the current design. A valid selection is evaluated by PyPSA, followed by OpenDSS if the system solve succeeds. The evaluator interprets the cycle record, and the critic reviews that record together with the evaluation. The procedure refiner then updates the advisory graph, the compressor records a structured summary, and the convergence judge decides whether to continue or stop. Roles use separate model-call contexts and exchange information through explicitly supplied records. Across cycles, the framework retains the current design, latest system and feeder evidence, accumulated cycle summaries and advisory graph. The judge additionally receives a code-computed outcome trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个多智能体循环开始时，系统架构、可再生能源发电、储能和可靠发电四个领域的专家智能体接收相同的共享状态以及程序图建议指导。 它们各自独立提出修改建议，在该循环中无法查看彼此的提案。 编排器接收全部四份提案，并选择一个实验，该实验可以合并若干提案的修改，也可以保留当前设计。 有效选择由 PyPSA 进行评估，若系统求解成功，则接着由 OpenDSS 进行评估。 评估器解读该循环记录，评审者则结合评估结果共同审阅该记录。 随后，程序优化器更新建议图，压缩器记录一份结构化摘要，收敛判定器决定是继续还是停止。 各角色使用独立的模型调用上下文，并通过显式提供的记录交换信息。 跨循环时，该框架会保留当前设计、最新的系统与馈线证据、累积的循环摘要以及建议图。 判定器还会额外接收一条由代码计算得出的结果轨迹。

paragraphs.en: The procedure graph contains planning steps with directed edges, conditions, guidance and pitfalls, inspired by procedural memory [ 21 ] . It begins with a six-node expert skeleton and is limited to thirty nodes and sixty edges with bounded text fields. Structurally valid edits are applied and logged. Their contents provide advice without altering tools or numerical requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 该流程图包含带有有向边、条件、指导和陷阱的规划步骤，其灵感来源于程序性记忆 [ 21 ] 。 它从一个六节点的专家骨架开始，并限制在三十个节点和六十条边以内，文本字段长度有限。 结构上有效的编辑会被应用并记录。 其内容提供建议，而不改变工具或数值要求。

sents.zh: 该流程图包含带有有向边、条件、指导和陷阱的规划步骤，其灵感来源于程序性记忆 [ 21 ] 。

sents.zh: 结构上有效的编辑会被应用并记录。

sents.zh: 其内容提供建议，而不改变工具或数值要求。

paragraphs.en: Every successful committed system evaluation triggers an OpenDSS check. A distribution-only edit invalidates feeder evidence while preserving a matching system dispatch, whereas a system-design edit invalidates both. The convergence judge can request up to two system-only verifications of hypothetical alternatives within a judge session. Their outputs are logged and used for that session’s decision to continue or stop. They are not included in subsequent-cycle prompts and do not establish physical acceptance. The single agent requests termination through finish_design , and the multi-agent judge issues its verdict through judge_convergence . These stopping decisions are subject to current-evidence requirements, and the configured search ceilings limit further execution. Stopping does not itself establish physical acceptance. The selected accepted candidate and the last attempt are recorded separately.
paragraphs.zh: 每次成功提交的系统评估都会触发一次 OpenDSS 检查。 仅配电层的编辑会使馈线证据失效，同时保留匹配的系统调度；而系统设计层面的编辑则会使两者都失效。 收敛裁判在一次裁判会话内最多可以请求两次针对假设性备选方案的仅系统层验证。 这些验证的输出会被记录，并用于该会话中关于继续或停止的决策。 它们不会被包含在后续周期的提示词中，也不会确立物理验收。 单智能体通过 finish_design 请求终止，多智能体裁判通过 judge_convergence 给出裁定。 这些停止决策须满足当前证据要求，且配置的搜索上限会限制进一步的执行。 停止本身并不确立物理验收。 被选中的已接受候选方案与最后一次尝试会被分别记录。

paragraphs.en: Provider adapters translate a common action vocabulary to OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages. The reported deployments are GPT-6.1 Sol ( gpt-6.1-sol ) and Claude Opus 5.5 ( claude-opus-5-5 ) [ 49 ] . Within each multi-agent run, all roles use the same model deployment, with specialization provided by role-specific instructions and inputs. Hosted models use their provider’s high effort setting, with the recorded inference configurations in Appendix 6 . We use the pretrained deployments without updating model weights or constructing a task-specific training set. Adaptation is confined to the recorded conversation, strategy notes, advisory procedure graph and proposed actions.
paragraphs.zh: 提供商适配器将统一的动作词汇表转换为 OpenAI Responses 与 Anthropic Messages 的格式。 所报告的部署为 GPT-6.1 Sol（gpt-6.1-sol）和 Claude Opus 5.5（claude-opus-5-5）[49]。 在每次多智能体运行中，所有角色均使用相同的模型部署，专门化通过角色特定的指令与输入来提供。 托管模型使用其提供商的 high effort 设置，所记录的推理配置见附录 6。 我们使用预训练部署，不更新模型权重，也不构建任务特定的训练集。 适配仅限于所记录的对话、策略笔记、咨询流程图以及提出的动作。

paragraphs.en: The primary and completed hosted-weather campaigns permit 120 single-agent turns, forty committed simulation requests and 120 multi-agent cycles for both deployments. The default response ceiling is 64,000 tokens, with smaller role-specific ceilings retained. Each multi-agent cycle contains several role-specific responses. The earlier base-year trajectories retain their recorded execution settings in Appendix 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 主要的和已完成的托管天气战役允许 120 次单智能体轮次、四十次已承诺的仿真请求以及 120 次多智能体循环，适用于两个部署。 默认响应上限为 64,000 个 token，同时保留了较小的角色特定上限。 每个多智能体循环包含若干角色特定的响应。 先前的基准年轨迹在附录 6 中保留了其记录的执行设置。

paragraphs.en: The runtimes record exact system-result reuse separately from numerical optimization. Eligible reuse requires matching system design, scenario, solver identity and solver settings, and preserves the archived optimal dispatch and objective evidence. Distribution-only controls can be changed while reusing a matching system dispatch, after which the requested feeder evaluation is performed. During the primary campaign, a separately recorded execution revision extended this matching to system-equivalent designs and retained the latest committed dispatch independently of the recent trial cache. The source and deployment manifests identify the affected trajectories. Logical evaluation requests, actual numerical solves and cache hits are distinct measures of effort. Reuse does not change the numerical acceptance requirements, but runtime and trajectory comparisons retain the execution-revision distinction. This revision applies from the interrupted NYISO 2035 GPT-6.1 Sol multi-agent verification onward, covering that trajectory and the seven subsequent GPT-6.1 Sol multi-agent trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时系统将精确的系统结果复用与数值优化分开记录。 符合条件的复用要求匹配系统设计、场景、求解器标识和求解器设置，并保留已归档的最优调度与目标函数证据。 仅涉及配电的控制可以在复用匹配的系统调度时进行更改，此后执行所请求的馈线评估。 在主执行阶段，一个单独记录的执行修订版本将此匹配扩展到系统等效的设计，并独立于最近的试验缓存保留最新提交的调度。 源清单与部署清单标识受影响的轨迹。 逻辑评估请求、实际数值求解和缓存命中是不同的工作量度量。 复用不会改变数值验收要求，但运行时和轨迹比较保留执行修订版本的区分。 该修订版本从中断的 NYISO 2035 GPT-6.1 Sol 多智能体验证开始适用，涵盖该轨迹及其后的七个 GPT-6.1 Sol 多智能体轨迹。

paragraphs.en: The primary reporting manifest selects forty completed carbon-constrained trajectories. A separate reference manifest retains the ninety-six trajectories from the original loose-cap evaluation. For each carbon trajectory, extraction reads its retained committed design, system result, distribution evidence, carbon-budget audit and numerical bound. The reported outcome is the lowest-cost accepted committed candidate selected by the retention rule in Eq. 5 . Physical and emissions checks are distinguished from the agent’s stopping decision. Source manifests preserve the result paths, scenario and implementation identities, and links to numerical and model-response records.
paragraphs.zh: 主报告清单选取了四十条已完成的碳约束轨迹。 另一份参考清单保留了原宽松约束评估中的九十六条轨迹。 对于每条碳轨迹，提取过程会读取其保留的已确定设计、系统结果、分布证据、碳预算审计和数值界限。 报告的结果是由式 5 中的保留规则所选出的成本最低的已接受已确定候选方案。 物理与排放检查不同于智能体的停止决策。 来源清单保留了结果路径、情景与实现标识，以及指向数值与模型响应记录的链接。

sents.zh: 主报告清单选取了四十条已完成的碳约束轨迹。

sents.zh: 另一份参考清单保留了原宽松约束评估中的九十六条轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Search histories, received-response tokens and process durations are reconstructed separately from the annual power-system objective (Section 4.13 ).
paragraphs.zh: 搜索历史、接收响应令牌和处理时长将与年度电力系统目标（第 4.13 节）分开重建。

paragraphs.en: Reference comparisons match system, demand year, resource profiles, deployment and architecture. Input-file hashes match for all forty pairs, with the source-derived carbon ceiling applied through the recorded scenario overlay. The reported contrasts describe observed trajectories, and any differences in provider configuration, recovery history and result-reuse revision remain attached to the pair. Numerical bounds are conditional on the optimization domain of each selected design. The comparison contains one trajectory per condition and does not establish a distribution of performance across repeated searches.
paragraphs.zh: 参考比较在系统、需求年份、资源曲线、部署和架构方面保持一致。 全部四十个配对的输入文件哈希值均一致，且通过记录的场景叠加应用了由数据源推导的碳上限。 所报告的对比描述的是观测到的轨迹，供应商配置、恢复历史和结果复用修订方面的任何差异仍附属于该配对。 数值边界取决于每个所选设计的优化域。 该比较对每个条件仅包含一条轨迹，并不能建立跨重复搜索的性能分布。

sents.zh: 参考比较在系统、需求年份、资源曲线、部署和架构方面保持一致。

paragraphs.en: We analyse the forty primary trajectories and the ninety-six loose-cap reference trajectories separately. A committed assessment is the chronological evaluation of a candidate after a system-simulation request or an additional feeder-only check; repeated designs and rechecks remain separate assessments. For the reference cohort, candidate reconstruction reproduces the hashes of all 382 assessed designs and links each archived selected design and objective to its first recorded assessment. The primary counts use the completed response ledgers and recorded committed and hypothetical system-evaluation requests. Native single-agent turns and multi-agent cycles are retained in the evidence; common comparisons use assessment order. A rejected improvement is an assessment whose recorded all-in objective is lower than an already accepted incumbent beyond the declared numerical comparison tolerance ( 10 − 6 10^{-6} in the recorded billion-per-year objective units), but which fails the acceptance gate. Such an objective does not represent a feasible saving. Uncommitted system-only probes are tabulated separately because they lack feeder validation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分别分析了四十条主轨迹和九十六条宽松上限参考轨迹。 一项已承诺评估是在系统仿真请求或额外的仅进料器检查之后对候选方案进行的按时间顺序的评价；重复的设计和复核仍算作单独的评估。 对于参考队列，候选重建复现了全部 382 个已评估设计的哈希值，并将每个存档的选定设计及其目标值链接到其首次记录的评估。 主计数使用已完成的响应账本以及记录在案的已承诺与假设性系统评估请求。 原生单智能体回合和多智能体循环均保留在证据中；常见的比较使用评估顺序。 被拒绝的改进是指这样一种评估：其记录的全含目标值低于某个已被接受的现任方案，且差距超出声明的数值比较容差（在记录的每年十亿单位的目标值中为 10^{-6}），但未通过接受门槛。 这样的目标值并不代表可行的节省。 未承诺的仅系统探测因缺乏进料器验证而单独列表统计。

sents.zh: 我们分别分析了四十条主轨迹和九十六条宽松上限参考轨迹。

sents.en: A rejected improvement is an assessment whose recorded all-in objective is lower than an already accepted incumbent beyond the declared numerical comparison tolerance ( 10 − 6 10^{-6} in the recorded billion-per-year objective units), but which fails the acceptance gate.
sents.zh: 被拒绝的改进是指这样一种评估：其记录的全含目标值低于某个已被接受的现任方案，且差距超出声明的数值比较容差（在记录的每年十亿单位的目标值中为 10^{-6}），但未通过接受门槛。

sents.zh: 这样的目标值并不代表可行的节省。

sents.zh: 未承诺的仅系统探测因缺乏进料器验证而单独列表统计。

paragraphs.en: We deduplicate received responses by provider and response identifier and reconcile 764 received responses in the primary cohort and 2,257 in the reference cohort with their archived ledgers and journals. Input tokens are normalized as uncached input plus cache reads plus cache writes; repeated context is counted each time it is supplied. Output tokens include the reported reasoning subset, so reasoning is not added again to the total. Tokens describe the complete selected search histories, including inherited responses exactly once within each retained trajectory. Responses from separate discarded attempts are excluded from these trajectory totals. Provider tokenizers and usage-reporting conventions differ.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按提供商和响应标识符对收到的响应进行去重，并将主队列中的 764 份收到的响应与参考队列中的 2,257 份收到的响应与其存档的账本和日志进行核对。 输入 token 被归一化为未缓存输入加上缓存读取加上缓存写入；重复提供的上下文在每次提供时都会被计入。 输出 token 包含报告的推理子集，因此推理不会再被加到总数中。 token 描述完整的选定搜索历史，包括继承的响应在每个保留的轨迹内恰好只计一次。 来自单独被丢弃尝试的响应被排除在这些轨迹总数之外。 各提供商的 tokenizer 和用量报告约定各不相同。

paragraphs.en: Matched comparisons pair single- and multi-agent trajectories within deployment, system and year. Aggregate ratios divide sums across a cohort, whereas median paired ratios summarize within-scenario quotients. Reference-cohort process-duration summaries use 92 trajectories and 44 pairs; four resumed reference histories lack full uninterrupted duration records. The primary campaign is not treated as a controlled wall-runtime benchmark because pauses, recovery and the result-reuse revision affect execution histories. Process duration covers the recorded workflow, and logged solver time is reported separately. Evaluation requests count logical calls, including exact-result reuse. All summaries are descriptive, with one trajectory per deployment–architecture–scenario cell.
paragraphs.zh: 匹配比较在同一部署、系统和年份内将单智能体与多智能体轨迹配对。 聚合比率是对一个队列的总和进行相除，而中位数配对比率是对场景内的商进行汇总。 参考队列的流程时长汇总使用 92 条轨迹和 44 个配对；四条恢复的参考历史缺少完整的无中断时长记录。 主要活动不被视为受控的挂钟运行时间基准测试，因为暂停、恢复以及结果复用修订都会影响执行历史。 流程时长覆盖已记录的工作流，日志记录的求解器时间单独报告。 评估请求按逻辑调用计数，包括精确结果复用。 所有汇总均为描述性汇总，每个部署–架构–场景单元对应一条轨迹。

paragraphs.en: We compare the retained carbon-constrained designs for Brazil and South Africa in 2035 with archived institutional planning outputs, without new inference or simulation. These two systems have explicit archived 2035 capacity mappings for the categories in Table 2 . All four accepted deployment–architecture trajectories per system are included. Capacity values are read from each retained candidate’s total-capacity record and checked against the final reported output. Minima and maxima span the four observed outcomes rather than statistical uncertainty. For capacity category k k , the descriptive difference is Δ ​ C k = C k agent − C k plan \Delta C_{k}=C^{\mathrm{agent}}_{k}-C^{\mathrm{plan}}_{k} in GW.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将2035年巴西和南非的保留碳约束设计方案与存档的机构规划产出进行比较，不进行新的推断或仿真。 这两个系统对表2中的类别具有明确的2035年存档容量映射。 每个系统的全部四条被采纳的部署—架构轨迹均包含在内。 容量值从每个保留候选方案的总容量记录中读取，并与最终报告的产出进行核对。 最小值和最大值覆盖的是四个观测结果，而非统计不确定性。 对于容量类别 k k，描述性差异为 Δ ​ C k = C k agent − C k plan \Delta C_{k}=C^{\mathrm{agent}}_{k}-C^{\mathrm{plan}}_{k}，单位为GW。

paragraphs.en: Each comparison retains the published capacity category. Model solar is a zonal allocation without a separate future distributed-generation rollout, so the solar differences cannot be interpreted as national photovoltaic surpluses. Demand, retirements, resources, costs, permitted technologies and delivery schedules retain the respective study assumptions. PDE 2035 supplies Brazilian demand and the numerical emissions ceiling adopted here; IRP 2025 supplies the South African emissions pathway, while South African demand uses ESRG. The comparison thus shares planning inputs with its institutional references and is not independent validation against withheld targets. The carbon-budget mappings, including Brazil’s CO 2 -equivalent proxy, are specified in Section 4.5 . The comparison archive retains all eight candidate identities, capacities, acceptance records, source hashes, workbook cells or page locators and calculations.
paragraphs.zh: 每次比较均保留已发布的容量类别。 太阳能模型是没有单独未来分布式发电推广的区域性配置，因此太阳能差异不能被解读为全国光伏盈余。 需求、退役、资源、成本、允许的技术和交付时间表保留各自研究的假设。 PDE 2035 提供巴西需求以及此处采用的数值排放上限；IRP 2025 提供南非排放路径，而南非需求使用 ESRG。 因此，该比较与其机构参考共享规划输入，并非针对保留目标的独立验证。 碳预算映射（包括巴西的二氧化碳当量代理）在第 4.5 节中规定。 比较存档保留了所有八个候选身份、容量、接受记录、源哈希、工作簿单元格或页面定位器以及计算。

paragraphs.en: Demand and fleet sources include EIA, ESRG, Eskom, AEMO, the New Zealand Electricity Authority, Transpower, CENACE, SENER, ONS and ANEEL. ERA5 provides the baseline weather, and NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 v2.0 provides the future daily climate fields [ 44 , 45 , 48 , 47 ] . The country-indexed source catalogue in Appendix 11 provides direct document links. The study archive retains source snapshots, geographic mappings, forecast targets, hourly resource profiles and input hashes. The manuscript evidence links each table and figure to its selected planning outcomes and comparison records. The carbon-constrained expert-plan comparison retains the eight Brazilian and South African 2035 candidates, document editions, workbook cells, category mappings and source hashes. The search-and-token archive contains the 96 reference assessment histories and the separately identified carbon-cohort response and evaluation records, with normalized response counts, token totals, role attribution, matched comparisons and source hashes. Carbon scenario records preserve the source-derived budgets, conversion assumptions and acceptance audits.
paragraphs.zh: 需求与机组组合数据来源包括 EIA、ESRG、Eskom、AEMO、新西兰电力局、Transpower、CENACE、SENER、ONS 和 ANEEL。 ERA5 提供基准天气数据，NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 v2.0 提供未来日尺度气候场 [ 44 , 45 , 48 , 47 ] 。 附录 11 中的按国家索引的来源目录提供了文档的直接链接。 研究存档保留了来源快照、地理映射、预测目标、逐小时资源曲线以及输入哈希值。 稿件证据将每张表和每幅图与其所选的规划结果和比较记录相关联。 碳约束下的专家方案比较保留了八名巴西和南非的 2035 年候选方案、文档版本、工作簿单元格、类别映射和来源哈希值。 检索与分词存档包含 96 个参考文献评估历史，以及单独标识的碳队列响应与评估记录，包括规范化响应计数、token 总量、角色归因、匹配的比较和来源哈希值。 碳情景记录保存了源自来源的预算、转换假设和验收审计。

paragraphs.en: The planning and analysis code is publicly available at https://github.com/sixticket/grid-agent . The repository contains the system simulator, regional scenario preparation, NASA-to-hourly reconstruction, model adapters, launchers and dependency records. The manuscript package includes the 96-trajectory reporting manifest drawn from the frozen Opus base-year and hosted-weather evidence, read-only committed-history extractors, table and figure generators, the frozen-evidence search-and-token table builder, and processing provenance for the 16 future-weather packs. A separate forty-trajectory manifest, fixed carbon-budget overlay, source catalogue, execution-revision manifest and carbon figure generators accompany the primary evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 规划与分析代码已在 https://github.com/sixticket/grid-agent 公开提供。 该仓库包含系统模拟器、区域场景准备、NASA 数据到逐小时数据的重建、模型适配器、启动器以及依赖记录。 稿件包包括源自冻结的 Opus 基准年与托管天气证据的 96 条轨迹报告清单、只读提交历史提取器、表格与图表生成器、冻结证据检索与词元表构建器，以及 16 个未来天气包的处理溯源信息。 一份单独的四十条轨迹清单、固定的碳预算覆盖层、来源目录、执行修订清单以及碳图表生成器随主要评估一并提供。

paragraphs.en: We thank the organisations whose public data made the regional package possible. The U.S. Energy Information Administration provided hourly demand (EIA-930) and the generator inventory (EIA-860). The New York Independent System Operator, the Midcontinent Independent System Operator and the Electric Reliability Council of Texas published the reliability, operating-study, resource-adequacy and transmission-planning documents from which zonal constraints and planned projects were taken, and the Public Utility Commission of Texas the 765 kV import-path approvals. The National Transmission Company South Africa published the Transmission Development Plan 2024 and Eskom the Integrated Report 2023 and station data. The Energy Systems Research Group at the University of Cape Town (G. Ireland and colleagues) published the spatialized South African demand model, and Meridian Economics and the PyPSA-ZA authors (J. Hörsch and J. Calitz) the open PyPSA-RSA model whose topology method we replicated. The Australian Energy Market Operator published the NEMWEB demand data, the registration lists, the interconnector capabilities and the Integrated System Plan; the New Zealand Electricity Authority the EMI datasets and Transpower the Transmission Planning Report; Mexico’s Centro Nacional de Control de Energía the real-demand reports and the Secretaría de Energía the PRODESEN; Brazil’s Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico the open data portal and the PEN, and ANEEL the SIGA plant register. The World Resources Institute provided the Global Power Plant Database and geoBoundaries the administrative boundaries. ERA5 reanalysis was produced by ECMWF under the Copernicus Climate Change Service and served through the Open-Meteo archive. NASA provided the NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 projections, including the MPI-ESM1-2-HR simulation used here. The National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly NREL) provided the Annual Technology Baseline, the reference turbine power curves and the System Advisor Model through PySAM, and the PyPSA project the technology-data repository. We used PyPSA, linopy, OpenDSS through OpenDSSDirect.py, HiGHS and Gurobi under an academic licence.

paragraphs.en: The primary evaluation contains forty carbon-constrained trajectories. Both deployments use a 64,000-token default output ceiling, high effort, 120 single-agent turns, forty committed single-agent simulation requests and 120 multi-agent cycles, with the recorded role-specific response ceilings. The scenario manifests retain the fixed budgets and the completed trajectory identities. Pause, recovery and system-result reuse records remain attached to the affected trajectories. A separate reference archive contains the ninety-six GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 trajectories described below. The sixteen Opus trajectories with 2023 demand and ERA5 2023 weather come from the earlier base-year campaign (frozen on 29 September 2026 at 23:35:46 UTC). The remaining eighty trajectories retain the settings of the later hosted campaign. Table 9 records the earlier Opus configuration.

paragraphs.en: GPT-6.1 Sol links successive Responses API requests through previous_response_id . Opus uses adaptive thinking, high effort and a five-minute prompt cache. Its revised adapter uses the thinking-binding-controls-2026-08-01 header and prefix_mismatch_behavior=drop_block so that strategy-note edits can update the system prompt under the preserved-thinking protocol [ 51 ] . Original response blocks remain in saved history; the server records exclusions of prefix-incompatible thinking blocks in input_transformations . Trajectory records identify the applied adapter, retained response history and provider-reported thinking transformations.

paragraphs.en: A separate completed campaign reports eighty hosted trajectories, with its final case completed on 3 October 2026 at 06:08:08 UTC (Table 10 ). It includes sixty-four cases with the prepared MPI-ESM1-2-HR SSP2-4.5 weather inputs for 2030 and 2035, and sixteen GPT-6.1 Sol controls with 2023 demand and ERA5 2023 weather. Both deployments use a 64,000-token default output ceiling, with 12,000-token critic requests; the single-agent ceiling is 120 turns and forty committed evaluations, and the multi-agent ceiling is 120 cycles. They share the agent workflow, action interface and physical acceptance rules, with the 8,760-hour horizon and numerical solver settings in Table 9 . GPT-6.1 Sol uses high effort and the standard tier; Opus uses the revised thinking protocol above with high effort and the standard-only tier. Original execution identities and complete response ledgers remain attached to each trajectory. Three resumed trajectories have no uninterrupted wall-runtime estimate; their retained numerical evidence and unique received responses are counted once.

paragraphs.en: In the loose-cap reference evaluation, the engine’s default design permits all extendable technologies, sets capacity bounds to their maxima and uses four-hour batteries without feeder interventions. This default is the least-cost plan that the optimizer returns without agent restrictions under the original carbon ceiling. It passes the gate in 17 of the 24 system–year problems and fails only the distribution component in seven. The 28 trajectories for those seven problems comprise twelve South African, eight ERCOT, four Mexican and four NYISO trajectories; all subsequently retain an accepted candidate. In 46 of the 56 trajectories that retain the default design, agents test 99 alternatives before stopping, comprising 60 hypothetical system-only checks and 39 committed designs; none is cheaper. The remaining 12 trajectories in the passing problems select modified designs that are up to 0.483% cheaper. Twelve initial rejections occur in the 2023 cohort and eight in each future-year cohort. The records show transitions from rejected to accepted planning candidates in multiple systems.
paragraphs.zh: 在宽松上限参考评估中，引擎的默认设计允许所有可扩展的技术，将其容量界限设为最大值，并使用四小时电池而不进行馈线干预。 该默认设计是在原有碳上限下、没有智能体限制时优化器返回的最低成本方案。 它在24个系统-年度问题中的17个通过了闸门，仅在7个问题的配电环节未通过。 这7个问题对应的28条轨迹包括12条南非轨迹、8条ERCOT轨迹、4条墨西哥轨迹和4条NYISO轨迹；所有这些轨迹随后都保留了一个被接受的候选方案。 在保留默认设计的56条轨迹中，有46条轨迹里的智能体在停止前测试了99个备选方案，其中包括60个假设性的仅系统层检验和39个已提交的设计；没有一个更便宜。 在通过的这些问题中，其余12条轨迹选择了最多便宜0.483%的修改设计。 12次初始拒绝出现在2023年组，未来各年份组各出现8次。 记录显示，在多个系统中规划候选方案经历了从被拒绝到被接受的转变。

sents.en: In the loose-cap reference evaluation, the engine’s default design permits all extendable technologies, sets capacity bounds to their maxima and uses four-hour batteries without feeder interventions.
sents.zh: 在宽松上限参考评估中，引擎的默认设计允许所有可扩展的技术，将其容量界限设为最大值，并使用四小时电池而不进行馈线干预。

sents.en: This default is the least-cost plan that the optimizer returns without agent restrictions under the original carbon ceiling.
sents.zh: 该默认设计是在原有碳上限下、没有智能体限制时优化器返回的最低成本方案。

sents.en: It passes the gate in 17 of the 24 system–year problems and fails only the distribution component in seven.
sents.zh: 它在24个系统-年度问题中的17个通过了闸门，仅在7个问题的配电环节未通过。

sents.en: The 28 trajectories for those seven problems comprise twelve South African, eight ERCOT, four Mexican and four NYISO trajectories; all subsequently retain an accepted candidate.
sents.zh: 这7个问题对应的28条轨迹包括12条南非轨迹、8条ERCOT轨迹、4条墨西哥轨迹和4条NYISO轨迹；所有这些轨迹随后都保留了一个被接受的候选方案。

sents.en: In 46 of the 56 trajectories that retain the default design, agents test 99 alternatives before stopping, comprising 60 hypothetical system-only checks and 39 committed designs; none is cheaper.
sents.zh: 在保留默认设计的56条轨迹中，有46条轨迹里的智能体在停止前测试了99个备选方案，其中包括60个假设性的仅系统层检验和39个已提交的设计；没有一个更便宜。

sents.en: The remaining 12 trajectories in the passing problems select modified designs that are up to 0.483% cheaper.
sents.zh: 在通过的这些问题中，其余12条轨迹选择了最多便宜0.483%的修改设计。

sents.en: Twelve initial rejections occur in the 2023 cohort and eight in each future-year cohort.
sents.zh: 12次初始拒绝出现在2023年组，未来各年份组各出现8次。

sents.en: The records show transitions from rejected to accepted planning candidates in multiple systems.
sents.zh: 记录显示，在多个系统中规划候选方案经历了从被拒绝到被接受的转变。

paragraphs.en: A separate Opus 5.5 multi-agent ERCOT 2035 trajectory illustrates how the framework links regional capacity choices to a physical check outside the annual system objective (Fig. 2 ). paragraphs.en: The selected accepted candidate combines a changed portfolio and battery operation with the Far West line-upgrade decision. The upgrade increases both representative-line ratings from 400 to 600 A and halves their impedances under the declared intervention model. The final Far West feeder has no voltage violations, thermal overloads or nonconverged hours; its annual voltage range is 0.974–1.015 p.u., and the second line’s annual peak current is 65.2% of its upgraded rating. All eight ERCOT representative feeders pass.
paragraphs.zh: 所选的可接受方案将变更的线路组合与电池运行同 Far West 线路升级决策相结合。 在所声明的干预模型下，该升级将两条代表性线路的额定容量从 400 A 提高到 600 A，并将其阻抗减半。 最终的 Far West 馈线没有电压越限、热过载或不收敛小时；其年度电压范围为 0.974–1.015 p.u.，第二条线路的年度峰值电流为其升级后额定容量的 65.2%。 全部八条 ERCOT 代表性馈线均通过。

These outcomes connect zonal additions, a named feeder intervention and the resulting acceptance record.

paragraphs.en: The 96 trajectories contain 382 committed candidate assessments, including 369 system-simulation requests and thirteen additional feeder-only assessments. Of these, 307 pass the recorded acceptance gate and 75 fail its distribution component. The median trajectory contains three assessments (range, one to eighteen). The selected candidate first appears at assessment one in 56 trajectories and later in 40; 35 trajectories improve the objective after their first accepted candidate. In 28 trajectories, the selected candidate’s source assessment precedes the last assessment. Fifteen of these end by rechecking the same design, whereas thirteen end with a different design. Thus, the source of the selected outcome and the final evaluated proposal convey different information about the search.

paragraphs.en: Sixteen trajectories produce 36 subsequent assessments with a lower recorded objective than an already accepted incumbent but fail distribution validation. In the Opus ERCOT 2035 multi-agent example (Fig. 2 ), round four supplies the selected accepted design. Removing feeder reinforcement in round six lowers the objective by 0.220% but introduces three undervoltage hours. Round seven restores the accepted design, leaving round four as its selected source. A further 228 uncommitted system-only probes inform exploration across the cohort; their results cover the system model and are reported separately from committed feeder assessments. paragraphs.en: The year-matched evaluation contains 96 completed annual trajectories. Thirty-two pair 2023 demand with ERA5 2023 resources; sixty-four pair 2030 or 2035 demand with resource profiles reconstructed for the same target year. Every trajectory yields a committed candidate satisfying the implemented system and representative-feeder acceptance gate. The eighty newly completed hosted trajectories also undergo independent reconstruction of committed candidate selection and recomputation of the physical gate from their retained numerical outputs. The evidence package preserves input and implementation identities, accepted candidates, costs, stopping decisions and recorded search effort. Appendix 8 reports the complete descriptive outcome tables and deployment comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 年份匹配的评估包含 96 条已完成的年度轨迹。 其中 32 条将 2023 年需求与 ERA5 2023 年资源配对；64 条将 2030 年或 2035 年需求与为同一目标年份重建的资源曲线配对。 每条轨迹都产出一个满足已实施系统与代表性馈线验收门槛的已承诺候选方案。 新完成的 80 条托管轨迹还须对已承诺候选方案的选择进行独立重建，并根据其保留的数值输出重新计算物理门槛。 证据包保存输入与实现标识、被接受的候选方案、成本、停止决策以及记录的搜索工作量。 附录 8 报告完整的描述性结果表和部署比较。

paragraphs.en: The complete reported search histories contain 2,257 distinct received model responses, totalling 276.386 million input tokens and 3.834 million output tokens (Table 7.7 ). Input includes cache reads and writes; output includes the reported reasoning subset. Across 48 trajectories per architecture, multi-agent input and output totals are respectively 2.08 and 23.34 times their single-agent counterparts. Every one of the 48 pairs matched by deployment, system and year uses more output tokens in the multi-agent configuration. The median paired output ratio is 5.94 for Sol and 25.10 for Opus. Input increases in 28 pairs; for Sol, the median paired input ratio is 0.74 despite an aggregate ratio of 1.55, reflecting a small number of large search histories. Totals, means and medians therefore describe distinct aspects of the observed effort. These comparisons describe search effort in the configured deployments.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的报告搜索历史包含 2,257 条不同的已接收模型响应，共计 2.76386 亿输入 token 和 383.4 万输出 token（表 7.7）。 输入包括缓存读取和写入；输出包括所报告的推理部分。 在每种架构 48 条轨迹中，多智能体的输入和输出总量分别是单智能体对应值的 2.08 倍和 23.34 倍。 在按部署、系统和年份匹配的 48 对中，每一对在多智能体配置下都使用了更多的输出 token。 配对输出比率的中位数在 Sol 上为 5.94，在 Opus 上为 25.10。 输入在 28 对中有所增加；对于 Sol，尽管总体比率为 1.55，但配对输入比率的中位数为 0.74，这反映了少数规模较大的搜索历史的影响。 因此，总量、均值和中位数描述了所观察到的努力的不同方面。 这些比较描述了所配置部署中的搜索努力。

paragraphs.en: The reported evidence comprises sixteen Claude Opus 5.5 trajectories with 2023 demand and ERA5 2023 weather, plus forty-eight GPT-6.1 Sol and thirty-two Opus trajectories from the completed hosted-weather campaign. The latter includes sixteen Sol 2023 ERA5 controls and sixty-four future-weather cases. A reporting manifest selects these 96 trajectories, each with matching demand and resource-weather years. Extraction reconstructs committed candidates, applies the common acceptance gate and selects the minimum-cost accepted candidate in Eq. 5 . Source manifests link the selected design to its system result, dispatch, feeder checks and model-response records. For all eighty new cases, reconstruction of the full committed history yields the same selected design and cost as the archived final; physical acceptance is recomputed from the recorded numerical results without new inference or optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 所报告的证据包括十六条使用2023年需求与ERA5 2023年气象数据的Claude Opus 5.5轨迹，外加来自已完成的托管气象活动的四十八条GPT-6.1 Sol轨迹和三十二条Opus轨迹。 后者包括十六条Sol 2023 ERA5对照案例和六十四条未来气象案例。 一份报告清单选出这96条轨迹，每条轨迹的需求年份与资源-气象年份相匹配。 提取过程重建已提交的候选方案，应用统一的接受门槛，并根据式5选出成本最低的获接受候选方案。 源清单将所选设计与其系统结果、调度、馈线校验和模型响应记录相关联。 对于全部八十个新案例，对完整提交历史的重建得到与归档最终结果相同的所选设计和成本；物理接受性基于记录的数值结果重新计算，无需新的推理或优化。

Solver bounds apply to the optimization problem within each selected design domain.

paragraphs.en: Claude Opus 5.5 runs sixteen trajectories with 2023 demand and ERA5 2023 weather, with both architectures in each of the eight systems (Table 12 ). Every selected candidate passes the same code-computed system and representative-feeder conditions. Selection retains the lowest all-in annual cost among physically accepted committed candidates. Together with the sixteen GPT-6.1 Sol 2023 controls, these results give thirty-two baseline trajectories (Fig. H1 ).
paragraphs.zh: Claude Opus 5.5 在 2023 年需求和 ERA5 2023 年天气条件下运行十六条轨迹，八个系统中的每个系统都包含两种架构（表 12）。 每个选定的候选方案都通过相同的代码计算系统条件和代表性馈线条件。 选择在物理上被接受的已承诺候选方案中保留全包年成本最低的方案。 结合十六条 GPT-6.1 Sol 2023 对照轨迹，这些结果共构成三十二条基线轨迹（图 H1）。

paragraphs.en: The completed hosted campaign adds eighty annual trajectories, comprising sixteen GPT-6.1 Sol controls with 2023 demand and ERA5 2023 weather, and sixty-four future-weather trajectories with GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5. Each future deployment covers eight systems, 2030 and 2035 demand, and both architectures. NASA MPI-ESM1-2-HR SSP2-4.5 daily fields and ERA5 2023 intraday templates supply the target-year resource profiles (Methods, Section 4.10 ). All eighty selected candidates pass the recomputed system and representative-feeder acceptance gate. Full committed-history reconstruction confirms that each selected result is the lowest-cost physically accepted committed candidate. All trajectories end through their single-agent finish decision or multi-agent judge.
paragraphs.zh: 完成的托管活动新增了八十条年度轨迹，其中包括十六条采用2023年需求和ERA5 2023年天气的GPT-6.1 Sol控制组轨迹，以及六十四条采用GPT-6.1 Sol和Claude Opus 5.5的未来天气轨迹。 每个未来部署涵盖八个系统、2030年和2035年的需求以及两种架构。 NASA MPI-ESM1-2-HR SSP2-4.5日尺度场数据和ERA5 2023日内模板提供目标年份的资源概况（方法，第4.10节）。 所有八十个选定的候选方案均通过重新计算的系统与代表性馈线验收门槛。 完整的已提交历史重构确认每个选定结果都是成本最低、物理上可接受的已提交候选方案。 所有轨迹均通过其单智能体完成决策或多智能体评判结束。

paragraphs.en: Across the 32 matched future-weather deployment pairs, Opus selects a lower annual cost in 1, an equal cost to the nearest cent in 18, and a higher cost in 13. The candidate-specific solver intervals overlap in 18 pairs. Shared demand, weather, inventory and network hashes, numerical settings and physical-code hashes are verified for all 32 pairs; all sixteen single-agent initial exposed states also match. Figure H2 shows achieved costs and their candidate-conditional numerical bounds.
paragraphs.zh: 在 32 对匹配的未来天气部署场景中，Opus 在 1 对中选择更低的年度成本，在 18 对中成本精确到分完全相同，在 13 对中选择更高的成本。 特定候选求解器的区间在 18 对中相互重叠。 所有 32 对的共享需求、天气、库存与网络哈希、数值设置以及物理代码哈希均已验证一致；全部十六个单智能体初始暴露状态也均匹配。 图 H2 展示了已实现的成本及其候选条件下的数值边界。

paragraphs.en: Selected-cost differences vary across architecture pairs. Across the sixteen future region–year architecture pairs per deployment, GPT-6.1 Sol’s multi-agent candidate is cheaper in one, equal to the nearest cent in seven and more expensive in eight. Opus’s corresponding counts are three, ten and three. In Opus ERCOT 2035, multi-agent selection reduces annual cost from USD 83.762708 billion to USD 83.150660 billion (USD 612.048 million; 0.731%). In South Africa 2035, it reduces cost from USD 14.202359 billion to USD 14.101251 billion (USD 101.108 million; 0.712%). Conversely, the MISO 2035 single-agent selections cost approximately 0.48% less than their multi-agent counterparts in both deployments. These are achieved outcomes of individual searches, with feasibility, economic improvement and stopping effort reported separately.
paragraphs.zh: 选择成本的差异在不同架构组合之间有所不同。 在每次部署的十六个未来区域-年份架构组合中，GPT-6.1 Sol 的多智能体候选方案在一个组合中更便宜，在七个组合中与最接近的百分点相同，在八个组合中更昂贵。 Opus 对应的数量分别为三、十和三。 在 Opus ERCOT 2035 中，多智能体选择使年度成本从 837.62708 亿美元降至 831.50660 亿美元（6.12048 亿美元；0.731%）。 在南非 2035 中，成本从 142.02359 亿美元降至 141.01251 亿美元（1.01108 亿美元；0.712%）。 相反，在两个部署中，MISO 2035 的单智能体选择比对应的多智能体方案成本低约 0.48%。 这些是单次搜索所实现的成果，其中可行性、经济改进和停止努力分别予以报告。

paragraphs.en: Across the new hosted campaign, GPT-6.1 Sol records 244 committed and 132 verification requests, with 1,493 unique received responses. Opus records 87 committed and 70 verification requests, with 544 responses. The median multi-agent search length is one cycle in each deployment/year cohort; the longest new searches occur in Sol ERCOT 2030 (eighteen cycles) and South Africa 2030 (fifteen). Ledger attribution counts each inherited or newly received response once; three resumed trajectories have no uninterrupted wall-runtime estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 在新的托管活动中，GPT-6.1 Sol 记录了 244 个已提交请求和 132 个验证请求，收到 1,493 个唯一响应。 Opus 记录了 87 个已提交请求和 70 个验证请求，收到 544 个响应。 各部署/年份分组中，多智能体搜索长度的中位数为一个周期；最长的新搜索出现在 Sol ERCOT 2030（十八个周期）和南非 2030（十五个周期）。 账本归因对每个继承或新收到的响应只计数一次；有三条恢复的轨迹没有连续的墙钟运行时间估计。

paragraphs.en: This section reports the ninety-six trajectories under the original 1,000 Mt annual ceiling. Tables 10 and 10 retain every trajectory. Each paired entry is single/multi for the same system and year. Assessments include feeder-only rechecks; their selected index identifies the first occurrence of the retained candidate. Failed assessments fail the recorded distribution check. Probes are uncommitted system-only verifications without feeder acceptance. Repeated designs remain separate assessments. Input tokens include cache reads and writes, and output includes the reasoning subset. Full-precision counts, native round/turn indices, role attribution and response provenance are supplied in the frozen evidence archive.
paragraphs.zh: 本节报告原始 1,000 Mt 年度上限下的九十六条轨迹。 表 10 与表 10 保留了全部轨迹。 每组成对条目是同一系统与同一年的单/多结果。 评估包括仅针对 feeder 的复核；其选定的索引标示被保留候选的首次出现。 未通过的评估即未通过所记录的分布检查。 探测是未提交的仅系统验证，不包含 feeder 接受。 重复的设计仍作为独立评估。 输入 token 包括缓存读取与写入，输出包括推理部分。 全精度计数、原生 round/turn 索引、角色归属与响应来源均收录于冻结的证据档案中。

paragraphs.en: Demand and fleet records use EIA-930 and EIA-860 , with ERCOT weather-zone maps and 2023 NYCA generator-zone assignments . Demand outlooks are MISO 2026 LTLF regional supplementary data , ERCOT-adjusted 2025 LTLF and the 2026 NYISO Gold Book forecast tables and report . NYISO network sources are the 2024 RNA appendices , Summer 2025 Operating Study and final 2025–2034 CRP . MISO limits use the 2025–2026 LOLE study , corrected PRA results and SRIC/SREC posting ; projects use LRTP Tranche 1 , Tranche 2.1 and MTEP25 chapter 2 . ERCOT network assumptions refer to the 2025 RTP economic study , Permian Basin reliability plan , PUCT 765 kV approval and STEP Eastern Backbone recommendation .
paragraphs.zh: 需求与机组数据采用 EIA-930 与 EIA-860，并结合 ERCOT 天气区地图及 2023 年 NYCA 发电机区划分。 需求展望采用 MISO 2026 年 LTLF 区域补充数据、经调整的 ERCOT 2025 年 LTLF，以及 2026 年 NYISO Gold Book 预测表和报告。 NYISO 网络来源为 2024 年 RNA 附录、2025 年夏季运行研究以及最终的 2025–2034 年 CRP。 MISO 的限额采用 2025–2026 年 LOLE 研究、更正后的 PRA 结果及 SRIC/SREC 发布数据；项目采用 LRTP Tranche 1、Tranche 2.1 及 MTEP25 第 2 章。 ERCOT 网络假设参考 2025 年 RTP 经济研究、二叠纪盆地（Permian Basin）可靠性规划、PUCT 765 kV 批准以及 STEP 东部主干网建议。

paragraphs.en: Demand uses the ESRG Hourly Demand Model v2025 by Province and Demand Spatialization South Africa corrected regional outputs. The spatialization notebook retains 2017 calibration inputs; the experimental base demand year is 2023. Fleet totals use the Eskom Integrated Report 2023 snapshot of 31 March 2023; global plant coordinates and allocation weights are described in Methods. Network records use NTCSA GCCA line shapefiles and TDP 2025–2034 (TDP 2024), Public Report Rev. 2 . The expert comparison uses User-Friendly IRP 2025, Table 1 , printed page 31 (PDF page 41), combining the end-2025 base with scheduled 2026–2035 additions while retaining separate distributed-generation, CSP and hybrid categories.
paragraphs.zh: 需求采用按省份划分的 ESRG 2025版小时需求模型与南非需求空间化修正后的区域输出结果。 空间化笔记本保留了2017年的校准输入；实验性的基准需求年份为2023年。 机队总量采用 Eskom 2023年综合报告截至2023年3月31日的快照；全球电厂坐标与分配权重在方法部分中说明。 电网记录采用 NTCSA GCCA 线路 shapefile 与 TDP 2025–2034（TDP 2024）公开报告第2修订版。 专家对比采用《用户友好版 IRP 2025》表1（印刷页第31页，PDF 第41页），将2025年底的基础部分与2026–2035年的计划新增部分合并，同时保留分布式发电、CSP 与混合类别的独立分类。

paragraphs.en: The baseline uses AEMO 2023 price-and-demand records and the EMMS demand-term definitions ; five-minute TOTALDEMAND is averaged hourly. Fleet selection uses the archived Registration and Exemption List and December 2023 MMSDM DUDETAILSUMMARY records. Network assumptions use AEMO ’s Interconnector Capabilities ( version 5 of 25 September 2025 ) and 2024 ISP Appendix 5 . Demand growth uses 2026 NEM ESOO results, Step Change with the data-centre outlook ; financial-year growth is mapped to the calendar-2023 demand template as stated in Methods.
paragraphs.zh: 基准情景使用 AEMO 2023 年价格与需求记录以及 EMMS 需求项定义；五分钟 TOTALDEMAND 被按小时平均。 车队选择使用存档的注册与豁免清单以及 2023 年 12 月的 MMSDM DUDETAILSUMMARY 记录。 网络假设使用 AEMO 的联络线能力（2025 年 9 月 25 日第 5 版）以及 2024 年 ISP 附录 5。 需求增长使用 2026 年 NEM ESOO 结果，即包含数据中心展望的 Step Change 情景；财年增长率按方法部分所述映射到 2023 日历年的需求模板。

sents.en: The baseline uses AEMO 2023 price-and-demand records and the EMMS demand-term definitions ; five-minute TOTALDEMAND is averaged hourly.
sents.zh: 基准情景使用 AEMO 2023 年价格与需求记录以及 EMMS 需求项定义；五分钟 TOTALDEMAND 被按小时平均。

sents.zh: 车队选择使用存档的注册与豁免清单以及 2023 年 12 月的 MMSDM DUDETAILSUMMARY 记录。

sents.en: Network assumptions use AEMO ’s Interconnector Capabilities ( version 5 of 25 September 2025 ) and 2024 ISP Appendix 5 .

sents.en: Demand growth uses 2026 NEM ESOO results, Step Change with the data-centre outlook ; financial-year growth is mapped to the calendar-2023 demand template as stated in Methods.

Network assumptions use the Transmission Planning Report 2023 ; the 1,400 MW northward HVDC target and assumed southward increment retain their distinct status. Future demand uses Security of Supply Assessment 2026 and its supplementary data , Medium Demand April–September grid-exit-point offtake.
paragraphs.zh: 需求、机队、水电发电和连接记录使用电力局（Electricity Authority）EMI 批发数据集。 网络假设使用《2023 年输电规划报告》（Transmission Planning Report 2023）；1,400 MW 向北 HVDC 目标与假设的向南增量保持其各自独立的地位。 未来需求使用《2026 年供电安全评估》（Security of Supply Assessment 2026）及其补充数据，即 4 月至 9 月中等需求情景下的电网出网点受电量。

paragraphs.en: Mexico 2030 uses Mexico Programa Sectorial de Energía 2025–2030 (PROSENER) . Electricity-generation emissions paragraph: net-injected-electricity emissions peak in 2027, then decline 23.9% from 156.42 to 119 MtCO 2 e by the 2030 planning horizon. The archived source value is 119 MtCO 2 e/year; the adopted model ceiling is 119.000000000000 MtCO 2 per year.
